detail.title: The Blind Turkey
detail.abstract: Black Swans don't exist. What we call "unpredictable" is merely unpredicted by specific observers. The shock lives in the observer, not the event.

AI.tldr: 黑天鹅事件并非客观存在，而是特定观察者的认知局限造成的。所谓的"不可预测性"只是未被特定观察者预测到，真正的冲击存在于观察者而非事件本身。
AI.research_question: 黑天鹅事件是否真的存在？还是仅仅是观察者的认知局限？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统对黑天鹅事件的理解，认为所谓的不可预测事件实际上反映了观察者的认知限制而非事件本身的特性
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知心理学、观察者理论、不确定性理论
AI.method: 概念分析和理论论证
AI.findings: 黑天鹅事件并非客观存在，而是观察者认知局限的表现。事件的冲击源于观察者的预期与现实之间的差距
AI.theory_contributions: 重新定义黑天鹅概念，强调观察者认知在事件感知中的核心作用
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助决策者认识到自身认知局限，改进预测和风险管理策略

title: Climbing Mount Improbable: A Viable Path For Argentina's Fiscal Reform Through Imf-Backed Gradual Transition

detail.title: Climbing Mount Improbable: A Viable Path For Argentina's Fiscal Reform Through Imf-Backed Gradual Transition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it uses only publicly available data (government statistics, court rulings, legislative records) and does not involve human subjects research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
Why do some countries repeatedly fail to reform dysfunctional institutions despite sustained crises and technical expertise? 
This paper develops an evolutionary game-theoretic framework to explain constitutional lock-in, demonstrating that simultaneous veto points create "fitness peaks" resistant to reform even under severe economic stress. Through comparative analysis of 60 reform attempts (1980-2023) across 24 countries, I identify a quadruple lock-in mechanism where constitutional rigidity, judicial supremacy, fiscal federalism, and statutory ultraactivity multiply coordination costs exponentially. Argentina exemplifies this trap: 93 years of income tax without constitutional mandate, 31 years violating coparticipation reform requirements, and 0% success rate in labor market liberalization (60+ attempts since 1994). 

Using Monte Carlo simulations (10,000 iterations) calibrated to India's GST reform (2017), Brazil's consumption tax transformation (2023), and Chile's labor liberalization (1991-2006), I demonstrate that reform probability remains below 20% even under crisis conditions-unless preceded by decade-long coalition-building and credible compensation mechanisms. India's GST Council (132 meetings, 2016-2017) and Brazil's 50-year transition fund transformed zero-sum conflicts into positive-sum negotiations, reducing coordination costs sufficiently for crisis shocks to catalyze rather than destroy reform momentum. 

The paper formalizes Evolutionarily Stable Strategies (ESS) in constitutional design, showing that "Mount Improbable" has gentle slopes accessible only through patient institutional engineering. Policy implication: shock therapy systematically fails; gradual coalition-building succeeds with 35-58% probability over 8-12 years. 

This paper complements Lerer (2025), which diagnosed Argentina's Fiscal Trilemma as an Evolutionarily Stable Equilibrium. Where that paper explained why reform fails, this paper demonstrates how reform can succeed-not through shock therapy, but through crisis-catalyzed coalition-building informed by successful international precedents.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个演化博弈论框架来解释宪法锁定现象，发现同时存在的否决点会形成抵抗改革的"适应度高峰"。通过比较60个改革案例，识别出四重锁定机制：宪法刚性、司法至上、财政联邦制和法规超活性。研究表明，除非进行长达十年的联盟建设和可信补偿，否则改革概率低于20%。
AI.research_question: 为什么一些国家在持续危机和技术专长的情况下仍反复无法改革功能失调的制度？
AI.motivation: 解释为什么某些国家在面临严重经济压力时仍无法改革功能失调的机构，尽管存在技术专长和持续危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 演化博弈论框架，特别是演化稳定策略(ESS)在宪法设计中的应用
AI.method: 比较分析60个改革尝试（1980-2023年，24个国家）；蒙特卡洛模拟（10,000次迭代）校准印度GST改革、巴西消费税转型和智利劳动力自由化案例
AI.findings: 改革概率在危机条件下仍低于20%，除非进行长达十年的联盟建设和可信补偿机制；四重锁定机制（宪法刚性、司法至上、财政联邦制、法规超活性）指数级增加协调成本
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化宪法设计中的演化稳定策略(ESS)，展示"不可能之山"只有通过耐心的制度工程才能攀登
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：休克疗法系统性失败；渐进式联盟建设在8-12年内有35-58%的成功概率；危机催化而非破坏改革动力

title: Argentina's Fiscal Lock-in: Tax Reform as Extended Phenotype

detail.title: Argentina's Fiscal Lock-in: Tax Reform as Extended Phenotype

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author declares no competing interests, financial or otherwise, that could have influenced this research. This work was conducted independently without funding from any public or private institution. The author is a practicing attorney in Argentina but has no current or past professional relationships with AFIP (Federal Revenue Administration), the Ministry of Economy, provincial tax authorities, or any entities that would benefit financially from the conclusions of this research.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
Argentina's National Constitution (Art. 75 inc. 2) requires national direct taxes to be established "for determinate time." Yet the income tax created by Law 11,682 (1932) has operated continuously for 93 years without temporal limitation, making Argentina the only federal case globally where national income tax operates without constitutional amendment (contrast: USA Amendment XVI, 1913; Australia referendums 1910-1967; India Constitution 1950). 
Applying Extended Phenotype theory to fiscal institutions, I demonstrate that Argentina's tax system is not a rational design but the extended phenotype of a 1932 constitutional mutation that created an Evolutionarily Stable Equilibrium. 
Through historical analysis (1853-2025), quantitative fiscal data (2010-2024), genealogical analysis of Supreme Court precedents, and international comparative analysis, I identify an irresoluble Fiscal Trilemma: Argentina can simultaneously achieve only two of three objectives-constitutional compliance, fiscal sustainability, and provincial autonomy.

AI.tldr: 本文应用扩展表型理论分析阿根廷税收制度，发现其不是理性设计，而是1932年宪法突变的扩展表型，形成了进化稳定均衡。通过历史、财政数据、最高法院判例和国际比较分析，识别出阿根廷面临无法解决的三难困境：只能同时实现宪法合规、财政可持续性和省级自治中的两个目标。
AI.research_question: 阿根廷国家所得税为何能在没有宪法修正的情况下连续运行93年，而其他联邦国家需要通过宪法修正来建立国家所得税？
AI.motivation: 阿根廷宪法第75条第2款要求国家直接税必须"有确定期限"，但1932年建立的所得税已连续运行93年无时间限制，这是全球唯一的联邦案例，需要解释这一反常现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展表型理论（Extended Phenotype theory）应用于财政制度分析，将税收制度视为1932年宪法突变的扩展表型，形成进化稳定均衡。
AI.method: 历史分析（1853-2025）、定量财政数据分析（2010-2024）、最高法院判例谱系分析、国际比较分析。
AI.findings: 阿根廷税收制度不是理性设计的结果，而是1932年宪法突变的扩展表型，形成了进化稳定均衡。识别出无法解决的财政三难困境。
AI.theory_contributions: 将扩展表型理论应用于财政制度分析，提出财政制度作为宪法突变扩展表型的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了阿根廷财政制度的根本矛盾，为政策制定者提供了理解财政三难困境的理论工具，有助于制定更现实的财政改革策略。

title: Crypto ATMs: Material Effects of Virtual Currencies
affiliations: Cornell University - Samuel Curtis Johnson Graduate School of Management, University of Michigan at Ann Arbor - Department of Economics, HKU Business School, The University of Hong Kong and The University of Hong Kong - Department of Finance

detail.title: Crypto ATMs: Material Effects of Virtual Currencies
detail.abstract: How cryptocurrencies from the cyberspace influence household finance and the real world? We investigate the economic consequences of cryptocurrency adoption by the main street enabled by crypto ATM installation. Using a unique, hand-collected dataset, we identify a causal relationship between the staggered rollout of crypto ATMs and regions' increased crypto activity and financial participation, as well as an associated increase in local cybercrime and financial frauds. Our findings are especially pronounced on platforms facilitating monetary transactions and in regions with limited banking infrastructure, indicating that crypto ATMs function as shadow intermediaries primarily for unbanked and low-income households. A back-of-the envelope estimate suggests a net welfare gain, but with unequal distribution. Overall, our findings reveal that the liberalized and democratized nature of cryptocurrency exerts a multifaceted impact on the real economy, disrupting traditional financial systems by expanding participation in both the crypto and stock markets, while simultaneously contributing to a rise in cybercrime as an unintended consequence.

AI.tldr: 加密货币ATM机的部署通过扩大金融参与度对实体经济产生多方面影响，既促进了加密货币和股票市场参与，也增加了网络犯罪和金融欺诈，对无银行账户和低收入家庭影响尤为显著。
AI.research_question: 加密货币ATM机的安装如何影响家庭金融和实体经济？
AI.motivation: 研究加密货币从网络空间对现实世界家庭金融的影响，特别是通过加密货币ATM机这一具体渠道的经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 加密货币作为影子中介的理论框架，金融包容性与金融风险并存的双重效应理论。
AI.method: 使用手工收集的独特数据集，采用交错推出设计识别加密货币ATM机部署与区域加密活动之间的因果关系。
AI.findings: 加密货币ATM机部署增加了区域加密活动和金融参与度，同时导致当地网络犯罪和金融欺诈上升；在银行基础设施有限的地区影响尤为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了加密货币作为影子中介的作用机制，深化了对加密货币双重效应（金融包容性与风险并存）的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于加密货币ATM机监管的实证依据，帮助平衡金融创新与风险防控的关系。

title: Conversion of Natural Forests to Plantations Induced by Wood Pellet Expansion
affiliations: Le Moyne College and Oregon State University

detail.title: Conversion of Natural Forests to Plantations Induced by Wood Pellet Expansion
detail.abstract: The wood pellet industry has been expanding in the Southeastern United States in recent years as a result of the European biofuel policy. Anecdotal evidence suggests that the establishment of new pellet mills has encouraged landowners to convert ecologically valuable natural forests into more economically profitable plantations. However, previous literature has not empirically examined the impact due to data limitations. This paper is the first empirical study of the impact of the introduction of mills on the conversion from natural forest to plantations, using the Forest Inventory and Analysis database to distinguish between natural forests and plantations. We use a Difference in Differences framework with the Callaway and Sant’Anna estimator to estimate the impact of proximity to a wood pellet mill on the likelihood of natural forest conversion to plantation. We find that proximity to softwood-dominant wood pellet mills increases the likelihood of natural forest land converting to plantations.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证研究了美国东南部木屑颗粒厂对天然林转为人工林的影响，发现靠近软木为主的颗粒厂会增加天然林转为人工林的可能性。
AI.research_question: 木屑颗粒厂的引入如何影响天然林向人工林的转化？
AI.motivation: 欧洲生物燃料政策推动了美国东南部木屑颗粒产业的发展，有证据表明新颗粒厂的建立促使土地所有者将生态价值高的天然林转为经济收益更高的人工林，但此前缺乏实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物能源政策与土地利用变化理论，关注生物燃料需求对森林生态系统的影响。
AI.method: 使用森林清查与分析数据库区分天然林和人工林，采用Callaway和Sant'Anna估计器的双重差分框架，分析靠近木屑颗粒厂对天然林转化概率的影响。
AI.findings: 靠近软木为主的木屑颗粒厂显著增加了天然林转为人工林的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了木屑颗粒产业对森林转化影响的实证证据，丰富了生物能源政策环境效应的理论研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于生物燃料政策潜在环境影响的实证依据，有助于制定更可持续的森林管理政策。

title:
The Economic Cost of Non-Collaboration 

Quantifying the Trillions Lost When Great Powers Refuse to Coordinate
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
The Economic Cost of Non-Collaboration 

Quantifying the Trillions Lost When Great Powers Refuse to Coordinate
detail.abstract:
This treatise, authored under the pseudonym Aurelius Veritas, examines the economic and moral costs of non-collaboration between the United States and China during two systemic crises: the Global Financial Crisis (2008–09) and the COVID-19 Pandemic (2020–21). While both nations acted decisively — the U.S. through quantitative easing and liquidity facilities, and China through fiscal stimulus and directed credit — their responses were pursued in parallel silos rather than as a coordinated strategy.

Drawing on comparative policy analysis, counterfactual modeling, and empirical evidence, the study quantifies the trillions of dollars in lost global output, millions of additional unemployed, and amplified volatility in commodities, exchange rates, and debt trajectories that resulted from mistrust and rivalry. The findings suggest that coordination could have reduced global GDP losses by 20–30%, lowered peak U.S. unemployment by two percentage points, stabilized commodity whiplash, and eased emerging-market capital flight.

The analysis challenges conventional views that gains from international coordination are small, reframing mistrust itself as a measurable economic cost driver. It concludes with a moral imperative: great powers have a duty to collaborate in moments of systemic peril, as failure imposes avoidable costs on households, firms, and future generations.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美中两国在2008-09年全球金融危机和2020-21年新冠疫情危机期间缺乏合作的经济和道德成本，量化了因不合作导致的数万亿美元全球产出损失、数百万人失业增加，以及商品、汇率和债务轨迹的波动加剧。研究发现协调合作可减少20-30%的全球GDP损失，降低美国失业率峰值，稳定商品价格波动。
AI.research_question: 美中两国在系统性危机期间缺乏合作造成了哪些经济和道德成本？
AI.motivation: 尽管美中两国在危机中都采取了果断行动，但各自为政而非协调合作，这种非合作状态对全球经济造成了重大损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于比较政策分析、反事实建模和实证证据，将不信任本身视为可量化的经济成本驱动因素。
AI.method: 采用比较政策分析、反事实建模和实证证据分析。
AI.findings: 协调合作可减少全球GDP损失20-30%，降低美国失业率峰值2个百分点，稳定商品价格波动，缓解新兴市场资本外逃。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了国际协调收益微小的传统观点，将不信任重新定义为可衡量的经济成本驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化证据，表明大国在系统性危机期间有道德义务进行合作，以避免对家庭、企业和后代造成可避免的成本。

reference: Forest and Society, volume 7, issue 1, 2023[10.24259/fs.v7i1.22618]
title: Impact and Mitigation Measures of COVID-19 towards Food Security Through Participation in Forest Management by Community in Sook, Keningau District, Sabah
affiliations: and Universiti Malaysia Sabah

detail.title: Impact and Mitigation Measures of COVID-19 towards Food Security Through Participation in Forest Management by Community in Sook, Keningau District, Sabah

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This study was funded by Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) Grant under (SDK0166-2020) and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA), Japan. We acknowledge Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS), Center for International Forestry Research (CIFOR), Sabah Forestry Department, Bornion Timber Sdn. Bhd. and PACOS Trust for assisting in the completion of the study. Special to mention is the Sabah Association for Social Forestry (SASOF) research team.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was funded by Universiti Malaysia Sabah (UMS) Grant under (SDK0166-2020) and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA), Japan.

detail.abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has significantly impacted food security for the people due to the imposition of stringent measures to halt the spread of COVID-19 transmission. This study aimed to measure the community's perception of the level of COVID-19 impacts on their food security and to identify the community's participation in forest management around the Forest Management Unit (FMU) in Sook, Keningau District of Sabah, to improve their livelihood. A mixed-method approach was conducted where a total of 122 respondents were sampled using a questionnaire survey, focus group discussion with communities, and expert interviews to gather more valuable data. The result showed that the communities were primarily involved in forest management through employment, empowerment, capacity building, and decision-making, which could indirectly contribute to their food security. Meanwhile, the impacts of the COVID-19 transmission were found to moderately affect the people who live inside or adjacent to the forest. The impacts could be explained based on eight themes as the outcome of Principal Component Analysis (PCA): market access, food storage and safety, resource availability, adequate nutrition, food aid, affordability, continuous food supply, and food adaptation to shock. Communities were mainly involved in agricultural practices and could obtain resources from the forest to supplement their daily need. The communities raise a prominent issue regarding land tenure that needs to be resolved; thus, it is suggested that imperative action be considered to create a balance between conservation, economy, and social responsibilities.

AI.tldr: 本研究测量了COVID-19对沙巴Sook地区森林管理单位周边社区粮食安全的影响程度，并识别了社区参与森林管理的情况。研究发现社区主要通过就业、赋权、能力建设和决策参与森林管理，这间接促进了粮食安全。COVID-19对森林周边居民的影响程度中等，主要影响表现在市场准入、食物储存安全、资源可获得性等八个方面。
AI.research_question: COVID-19对森林管理单位周边社区粮食安全的影响程度如何？社区如何参与森林管理来改善生计？
AI.motivation: COVID-19大流行通过严格的防控措施显著影响了人们的粮食安全，需要了解其对森林周边社区的具体影响以及社区参与森林管理的现状。
AI.theoretical_framework: 森林管理与社区生计、粮食安全理论框架
AI.method: 混合研究方法：对122名受访者进行问卷调查、社区焦点小组讨论和专家访谈
AI.findings: 1. 社区主要通过就业、赋权、能力建设和决策参与森林管理；2. COVID-19对森林周边居民的影响程度中等；3. 影响主要表现在市场准入、食物储存安全、资源可获得性等八个主题；4. 社区主要从事农业实践并从森林获取资源补充日常需求；5. 土地权属是突出问题
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了COVID-19对森林周边社区粮食安全影响的具体实证证据，丰富了森林管理与社区生计关系的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 建议采取必要行动在保护、经济和社会责任之间建立平衡，为解决土地权属问题提供实践指导

title: The Arab Region 15 Years after the Uprising: Regression, Conflict, and Residual Hope
affiliations: International IDEA

detail.title: The Arab Region 15 Years after the Uprising: Regression, Conflict, and Residual Hope

publicationDetails.detailsText: Princeton University Program in Law & Public Affairs Research Paper No. 2025-12
publicationDetails.journalName: Princeton University Program in Law & Public Policy Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The 2011 uprisings in the Arab region marked a significant moment in history, setting in motion the largest concentration of constitutional negotiations anywhere in the world since the fall of the Berlin Wall. However, as of June 2025, the anticipated democratic reforms have largely failed to materialize. This article examines developments since 2011 throughout the region, with particular focus on constitutional reform processes in Tunisia and Syria. Tunisia, initially a beacon of hope, has regressed into authoritarianism. Syria has only recently witnessed major changes to its constitutional framework after fifteen years of brutal conflict, in a manner that, if successful, could encourage a new generation of conflict in the region and beyond. This article also critiques the framing of the constitutional debates that took place after 2011. The article argues that the discussion on constitutional reform was a 'wrong debate' that mischaracterised the nature of the challenges that the region is facing. As a result, the wrong solutions were prescribed, which unsurprisingly failed to produce the desired results. The article argues that the regional debate on constitutional reform failed to address historical legacies and societal divisions that hinder progress towards democracy. The debate on constitutional reform should be deliberately reframed around how to repair the damage caused by a century of colonial and post-colonial rulers to political culture and to state institutions as an initial step to promoting democracy and stability in the Arab region.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2011年阿拉伯地区起义后的宪政改革进程，认为宪政辩论是'错误的辩论'，未能解决阻碍民主的历史遗留问题和社会分裂，导致改革失败。

AI.motivation: 2011年阿拉伯起义引发了全球柏林墙倒塌后最大规模的宪政谈判，但到2025年民主改革基本失败，需要分析失败原因。

AI.findings: 突尼斯从民主希望倒退到威权主义；叙利亚在15年冲突后才有重大宪政变化，但可能引发新冲突；宪政辩论未能解决历史遗留问题

title: Geopolitical Risk and Bank Lending
affiliations: Durham University Business School and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Geopolitical Risk and Bank Lending
detail.abstract: Using a firm-level measure of geopolitical risk (GPR) exposure, this paper investigates the impact of bank-specific GPR on their lending behaviors using U.S. syndicated loans. We find that borrowers face a 15% increase in loan spreads (equivalent to 30 basis points) when their lenders’ perceived geopolitical risk is high. This effect is amplified for borrowers with greater reliance on global supply chains or foreign market exposure and for lenders with higher foreign exposure, headquartered in politically conservative states, or issuing loans during politically uncertain periods. We also find a loan re-portfolio effect: under heightened geopolitical uncertainty, lenders tend to reduce lending to firms in high GPR exposure industries while reallocating funds to firms in low GPR exposure industries.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，当贷款银行感知的地缘政治风险较高时，借款人面临15%的贷款利率上升（相当于30个基点）。这种效应在依赖全球供应链或外国市场敞口的借款人，以及具有较高外国敞口、总部位于政治保守州或在政治不确定时期发放贷款的贷款人中更为显著。此外，研究还发现了贷款组合重新配置效应：在地缘政治不确定性加剧时，贷款人倾向于减少对高GPR暴露行业的贷款，同时将资金重新配置到低GPR暴露行业。
AI.research_question: 银行特定的地缘政治风险如何影响其贷款行为？
AI.motivation: 研究银行层面的地缘政治风险对贷款决策的影响，填补了现有文献在微观层面分析地缘政治风险传导机制的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地缘政治风险理论、银行风险管理和贷款定价理论，构建银行GPR暴露对贷款行为影响的理论框架。
AI.method: 使用美国银团贷款数据，构建银行层面的地缘政治风险暴露指标，采用回归分析方法检验GPR对贷款利差和贷款组合配置的影响。
AI.findings: 1）借款人面临15%的贷款利率上升；2）效应在特定特征的借款人和贷款人中更显著；3）存在贷款组合重新配置效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从银行微观层面揭示地缘政治风险对贷款行为的传导机制，拓展了地缘政治风险在金融中介领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行风险管理提供实证依据，帮助借款企业理解地缘政治风险对融资成本的影响，为监管机构制定相关政策提供参考。

title: Virtue or Mirage? Complexity in Exchange Rate Prediction
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Virtue or Mirage? Complexity in Exchange Rate Prediction
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether the “virtue of complexity” (VoC), documented in equity return prediction, extends to exchange rate forecasting. Using Ridge regressions with Random Fourier Features (Ridge–RFF), we compare predictive performance against linear regression and the random walk benchmark across three sets of fundamentals—traditional monetary, expanded monetary and non-monetary, and Taylor-rule predictors—under rolling windows of 12, 60, and 120 months. Results offer a cautionary perspective. Complexity provides modest, localized gains: in very small samples with rich predictor sets, Ridge–RFF can outperform linear regression, but never delivers systematic improvements over the random walk. As training windows expand, Ridge–RFF quickly loses ground, while linear regression often matches or surpasses it, occasionally outperforming the random walk. Market-timing analyses reinforce this fragility: complexity-based strategies yield short-sample gains but are unstable, whereas linear and random walk strategies provide more robust value. Overall, evidence points to a limited virtue of complexity in FX forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在汇率预测中，复杂性（使用Ridge-RFF方法）仅能在小样本和丰富预测因子条件下带来有限的局部改进，但无法系统性地超越随机游走基准。随着样本量增加，线性回归往往表现更好，复杂性优势迅速消失。
AI.research_question: 汇率预测中的'复杂性优势'是否成立？即复杂预测方法能否系统性地优于简单方法？
AI.motivation: 基于股票收益预测中发现的'复杂性优势'现象，探讨这一优势是否能够扩展到汇率预测领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂性优势理论、汇率预测理论、机器学习在金融预测中的应用
AI.method: 使用带随机傅里叶特征的岭回归（Ridge-RFF），与线性回归和随机游走基准进行比较，涵盖三组基本面因子（传统货币、扩展货币和非货币、泰勒规则因子），在12、60、120个月滚动窗口下进行测试
AI.findings: 复杂性仅在小样本和丰富预测因子条件下带来有限的局部改进；随着训练窗口扩大，Ridge-RFF表现下降，线性回归往往表现更好；复杂性策略在市场择时中不稳定，而线性和随机游走策略更稳健
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了复杂性优势在汇率预测中的普适性，揭示了复杂性优势的条件依赖性
AI.practical_contributions: 为汇率预测实践提供了指导：在小样本情况下可谨慎使用复杂方法，但在大多数情况下简单方法可能更可靠

title: Conference Proceeding & SSRN Working Paper: Estimating the African Union’s SDG Production Frontier - The 7th Congress of African Economists (CAE)

detail.title: Conference Proceeding & SSRN Working Paper: Estimating the African Union’s SDG Production Frontier - The 7th Congress of African Economists (CAE)
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the policy relevance and empirical performance of public–private partnerships (PPPs) in closing Sub-Saharan Africa’s rural education infrastructure gap within the Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG4) framework. Using a thirty-year panel (1990–2020) across ten African Union (AU) Member States, the study develops an African General Equilibrium (AGE) model to estimate the region’s SDG production frontier and assess how social infrastructure PPPs affect foreign direct investment (FDI) inflows and fiscal equilibria. Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) and Fixed Effects regressions, combined with Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), are employed to quantify the relationship between FDI (% of GDP) and the African Infrastructure Development Index (AIDI) and its sub-indices for transport, electricity, ICT, and water and sanitation. The findings indicate that ICT infrastructure is a statistically significant determinant of FDI attraction, while other components exhibit weaker elasticities, suggesting an uneven distribution of infrastructure-driven growth effects. The paper further interprets PPPs through a micro-macro synthesis—linking Hicksian–Marshallian price equilibria with fiscal constraints and national trade balances—to propose an SDG production frontier consistent with AU development objectives. Policy implications highlight that sustainable PPP frameworks, supported by credible fiscal governance and design standardization (e.g., SCSD/URBS systems), are essential to ensure equitable and efficient education infrastructure delivery across Africa’s rural economies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在可持续发展目标4框架下，公私合作伙伴关系（PPPs）在缩小撒哈拉以南非洲农村教育基础设施差距方面的政策相关性和实证表现。研究发现ICT基础设施是吸引外国直接投资的重要决定因素，并提出了与非洲联盟发展目标一致的可持续发展目标生产前沿。
AI.research_question: 公私合作伙伴关系（PPPs）如何在可持续发展目标4框架下缩小撒哈拉以南非洲的农村教育基础设施差距？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲地区面临严重的农村教育基础设施不足问题，需要探索有效的政策工具来支持可持续发展目标4的实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非洲一般均衡模型（AGE）、希克斯-马歇尔价格均衡理论、财政约束与国际贸易平衡的微观-宏观综合分析框架
AI.method: 使用1990-2020年十年非洲联盟成员国面板数据，采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）、固定效应回归和最大似然估计（MLE）方法
AI.findings: ICT基础设施是吸引外国直接投资（FDI）的统计显著决定因素，而其他基础设施组成部分的弹性较弱，表明基础设施驱动增长效应的分布不均
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了与非洲联盟发展目标一致的可持续发展目标生产前沿，将希克斯-马歇尔价格均衡与财政约束和国际贸易平衡联系起来
AI.practical_contributions: 强调可持续的PPP框架、可信的财政治理和设计标准化（如SCSD/URBS系统）对于确保非洲农村经济体中教育基础设施的公平高效交付至关重要

title: Constitutional Lock-in and the Phenotypic Expression of Legal Regimes: Argentina's Labor Market as Irreversible Institutional Morphology

detail.title: Constitutional Lock-in and the Phenotypic Expression of Legal Regimes: Argentina's Labor Market as Irreversible Institutional Morphology

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, that could influence or be perceived to influence this research. This work was conducted independently without institutional affiliation or external funding.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on publicly available data (judicial decisions, legislative records, constitutional texts, published statistics) and does not involve human subjects research. Therefore, ethics approval was not required under standard research ethics protocols.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The work was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This article applies the IusMorfos framework to explain why Argentina's labor regime exhibits structural irreversibility despite 34 years of reform attempts across ideologically opposite administrations. Using a Constitutional Lock-in Index (CLI) measuring four dimensions (text vagueness, treaty hierarchy, judicial activism, precedential weight), we show Argentina scores 0.89positioning it 3.7× above Chile (0.24), 2.2× above Brazil (0.40), and 1.7× above Spain (0.51). Analysis of 23 Argentine reforms (1991-2025) reveals 0% sustained success with 18.3-month median reversal time, compared to Brazil (42.9% success), Spain (69.2%), and Chile (80.0%). Logistic regression (n=60 reforms, R²=0.74) confirms CLI as dominant predictor-each 0.1-unit increase reduces success odds 63%. Counter-intuitively, economic crisis intensifies rather than relaxes lock-in (β=-2.83, p=0.014). Argentina's extreme CLI stems from Art. 14 bis's semantic vagueness (90% abstraction) empowering judicial doctrine creation. CSJN's 71.4% pro-worker rate and precedents like Vizzoti (892 citations, 0.7% reversal probability) produce stable regulatory phenotype resistant to reform. Treaty hierarchy (Art. 75 inc. 22) creates dual lock-in-domestic plus international obligation-multiplicatively reducing reform space. Bayesian forecasting predicts 12.4% success probability for Milei reforms (2023-2025), contingent on low-probability events. This lock-in generates persistent welfare losses-45% informal employment,-0.3% productivity growth-without approaching institutional tipping points enabling transition.

AI.tldr: 本文应用IusMorfos框架解释阿根廷劳动制度的结构性不可逆性，尽管34年来不同意识形态政府进行了改革尝试。研究发现阿根廷的宪法锁定指数(CLI)高达0.89，远高于其他国家，导致改革成功率0%，中位逆转时间仅18.3个月。
AI.research_question: 为什么阿根廷的劳动制度表现出结构性不可逆性，尽管经历了34年不同意识形态政府的改革尝试？
AI.motivation: 理解阿根廷劳动改革持续失败的根本原因，以及宪法制度如何阻碍政策变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: IusMorfos框架，宪法锁定指数(CLI)测量四个维度：文本模糊性、条约层级、司法能动性、先例权重。
AI.method: 比较案例分析(阿根廷、巴西、西班牙、智利)，logistic回归分析(n=60改革)，贝叶斯预测。
AI.findings: 阿根廷CLI得分0.89，改革成功率0%，中位逆转时间18.3个月；CLI每增加0.1单位，改革成功几率降低63%；经济危机反而加剧锁定效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了宪法锁定理论，识别了制度不可逆性的机制，特别是文本模糊性和条约层级的双重锁定效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了预测改革成功率的工具，揭示了阿根廷劳动制度改革的根本障碍，对其他国家制度设计具有警示意义。

title: Gender, International Law and the Global Economy: Sketches of Alternative Legal Imaginaries from the 1970s
affiliations: University of Melbourne - Melbourne Law School

detail.title: Gender, International Law and the Global Economy: Sketches of Alternative Legal Imaginaries from the 1970s
detail.abstract: This chapter explores what a feminist approach to international economic law might look like through three rival events held in response to ‘International Women’s Year’ in the mid-1970s. These are the United Nations (UN) World Conference of the International Women’s Year in Mexico City in June and July 1975, the socialist World Congress of Women in East Berlin in October 1975, and the grassroots International Tribunal on Crimes against Women in Brussels in March 1976. These events took place against the backdrop of the Cold War and on the high tide of both the women’s liberation movement in the West and the global South’s pursuit of a New International Economic Order (NIEO) in the UN. Each event reflected its own political orientation, which was bound up with this historical context. The Mexico Conference was dominated by the South’s NIEO agenda, the East Berlin Congress worked as a ‘diplomatic stage’ for the Eastern Bloc to promote state socialism, and the Brussels Tribunal reflected the anti-statist approach of the women’s liberation movement at the time. Yet, despite their differences, all three events were concerned with how to overcome structural inequalities in the global economy and their gendered consequences. In this chapter, I draw out the plural, contested and oft-forgotten international legal imaginaries circulating at these events. In doing so, my aims are twofold. First, I aim to expose and denaturalise the narrowness of the World Trade Organisation’s recent trade and gender initiatives, which fail to reflect feminist concerns relating to the structure of the global economy. Second, by assembling a collection of alternative legal framings and ideas, I aim to provide impetus for reimagining international economic law in feminist, decolonial and anti-capitalist directions into the future.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析1970年代三个与"国际妇女年"相关的竞争性事件，探讨了国际经贸法的女权主义方法。这些事件包括联合国墨西哥城会议、东柏林社会主义世界妇女大会和布鲁塞尔民间妇女法庭，它们各自反映了不同的政治取向，但都关注全球经济中的结构性不平等及其性别影响。
AI.research_question: 女权主义视角下的国际经贸法应该是什么样的？
AI.motivation: 揭示和批判世贸组织近期贸易与性别倡议的局限性，这些倡议未能反映与全球经济结构相关的女权主义关切。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女权主义国际法理论、去殖民理论和反资本主义理论
AI.method: 历史分析，通过比较1970年代三个竞争性国际妇女事件（联合国墨西哥城会议、东柏林社会主义世界妇女大会、布鲁塞尔民间妇女法庭）来探讨不同的国际法律想象。
AI.findings: 三个事件虽然政治取向不同，但都关注克服全球经济结构性不平等及其性别后果；每个事件都反映了特定的国际法律想象：墨西哥会议主导南方国家的新国际经济秩序议程，东柏林会议作为东方集团推广国家社会主义的"外交舞台"，布鲁塞尔法庭反映了当时妇女解放运动的反国家主义方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了多元、有争议且常被遗忘的国际法律想象，为重新构想国际经贸法提供了理论资源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际经贸法向女权主义、去殖民和反资本主义方向的未来重构提供动力和替代性法律框架。

detail.abstract: In the fast-changing economy of India, the situation of poor workers needs a proper and detailed plan for social security that can meet their needs. As the country faces big gaps in income, jobs, and resources, it is very important for policymakers and stakeholders to grasp the complex nature of these issues. Government actions aimed at giving social security are vital for protecting the livelihoods of at-risk groups, especially when faced with economic instability worsened by global issues like pandemics and geopolitical conflicts. This chapter intends to look closely at the various government programmes created to shield poor workers, assessing how effective, accessible, and sustainable they are in the changing economic environment of India. By examining both formal and informal social protection systems, as well as their socioeconomic effects on different groups, it is clear that although some progress has been achieved, there are still significant gaps in how these measures are put into action and who they reach. Additionally, obstacles to access and lack of knowledge can hinder the benefits meant for those who need them most. The discussion will underscore the need for a more coordinated approach to social security that merges government and community efforts to boost social protection and support the most disadvantaged parts of society. Only through such a complete strategy can we hope to build a fairer future for all workers, allowing them to succeed despite challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度快速变化经济中贫困工人的社会安全状况，评估了政府社会安全计划的有效性、可及性和可持续性，指出实施和覆盖范围存在显著差距，强调需要政府与社区协调的方法来加强社会保护。

title: Normative Ambiguity as Memetic Niche Space: An Evolutionary Framework for Leibovitch & Teichman's Expressive Power Findings

detail.title: Normative Ambiguity as Memetic Niche Space: An Evolutionary Framework for Leibovitch & Teichman's Expressive Power Findings

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest to declare.

detail.abstract: Leibovitch and Teichman's recently published work in the Journal of Empirical Legal Studies (2025) demonstrates through randomized controlled trials that law's expressive power-its capacity to shape perceived social norms independent of material enforcement-is maximized in conditions of normative ambiguity. This finding challenges standard signaling models, which would predict clearer baseline norms to amplify legal signals. I propose that their empirical results reflect a fundamental evolutionary mechanism: normative ambiguity represents "niche space" in cultural memetic competition, where institutional signals gain selective advantage precisely because competing memes have not yet saturated the environment. Drawing on Dawkins' extended phenotype framework and Dennett's work on cultural evolution, I model legal norms as replicators competing for cognitive resources in structured landscapes. Ambiguous contexts create multiple "vacant niches" where memes can colonize with minimal competition, while contexts with clear normative information represent saturated environments where established memes resist invasion. Law operates as a "niche constructor," modifying the selective environment for social norms without requiring material coercion-a mechanism Leibovitch and Teichman's data validate empirically. This framework generates testable predictions extending beyond their initial findings: (1) expressive power should be stronger in low-trust institutional contexts where chronic ambiguity prevails; (2) the effect should vary with the "adaptive fitness" of proposed norms in local environments; (3) path dependence should be observable, with prior legal signals conditioning future receptivity. Application to the Argentine case, where "anomia boba" (Nino, 1992) creates chronic normative ambiguity, suggests particularly strong expressive effects-a hypothesis testable through replication of Leibovitch and Teichman's RCT design in non-WEIRD contexts. By providing a causal mechanism for their empirical observation, this evolutionary framework elevates an intriguing finding into evidence of a general principle governing legal norm formation across cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过进化论框架解释Leibovitch和Teichman的实证发现：法律在规范模糊条件下表达力最强，因为模糊环境为文化模因提供了未被占据的生态位空间，使法律信号获得选择优势。
AI.research_question: 为什么法律在规范模糊条件下的表达力最强？这一现象背后的因果机制是什么？
AI.motivation: Leibovitch和Teichman的实证发现挑战了传统信号理论，需要新的理论框架来解释这一反常现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化论框架、Dawkins的扩展表型理论、Dennett的文化进化理论、模因竞争理论
AI.method: 理论建模和概念分析，基于Leibovitch和Teichman的随机对照试验数据
AI.findings: 规范模糊创造了文化模因竞争的"生态位空间"，使法律信号在竞争最小的环境中获得选择优势
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了法律作为"生态位构建者"的理论框架，为法律表达力现象提供了进化论解释机制
AI.practical_contributions: 预测了法律表达力在不同制度环境下的变化规律，为跨文化法律移植和政策设计提供指导

title: The Economic Cost of Political Unrest: A Case Study of Nepal's 2025 Gen Z Protests
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Economic Cost of Political Unrest: A Case Study of Nepal's 2025 Gen Z Protests
detail.abstract:
This study looks into the long-term economic effects of the fallout from the 2025 Gen Z protest, both now and in the future. Political unrest erupted in the nation as a result of the September 8th protest, which was sparked by the growing frustration of ongoing governance failures, unemployment, and limited opportunities for young people. The results demonstrate the short-and long-term effects of the protest through a mixed-method approach that includes secondary data on tourism and trade, the opinions of reporters and businesspeople who were interviewed, newspaper news, economic trend analysis using historical data and statistics, and regional comparison. 

Results indicate that the aftermath of looting and arson in large corporate groups, such as the Chaudhary Group and Bhatbhateni Supermarket, caused billions of dollars in damages, interrupted internet service, and impacted retail supply chains across the country. Attacks on foreign hotels and resorts made cancellations even more common during the busiest trekking season. The Parliament building, Singha Durbar, and more than 500 other government buildings were destroyed or damaged, resulting in equally significant losses.

The study concludes that there is a greater chance of slower growth, declining investor confidence, and increased unemployment as a result of the current turmoil. Though it is on a precarious path, Nepal is not yet in danger of catastrophe, as evidenced by the lessons learned from Bangladesh's slowdown in 2024 and Sri Lanka's collapse in 2022. The nation can still avoid a more serious crisis with prompt political discussion, safeguarding remittance flows, providing targeted assistance for important industries, and working to win back investor trust.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨2025年Gen Z抗议事件的长期经济影响。研究发现抗议导致企业数十亿美元损失、供应链中断、旅游业受创，可能引发增长放缓、投资者信心下降和失业率上升。但尼泊尔仍可通过政治对话、保护汇款流动和恢复投资者信心避免更严重危机。
AI.research_question: 2025年Gen Z抗议事件对尼泊尔经济的短期和长期影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 2025年9月8日抗议事件由持续治理失败、青年失业和机会有限引发政治动荡，需要评估其经济后果。

AI.method: 混合方法研究：包括旅游贸易二手数据、记者和商人访谈、新闻报道分析、历史数据经济趋势分析、区域比较。
AI.findings: 抗议导致Chaudhary集团和Bhatbhateni超市等大企业数十亿美元损失，互联网中断，零售供应链受影响；外国酒店度假村遭攻击导致旺季取消；议会大厦等500多座政府建筑损毁。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了政治动荡对发展中国家经济影响的理论理解，特别是青年抗议对经济脆弱性的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供避免经济危机的具体建议：及时政治对话、保护汇款流动、针对性产业援助、恢复投资者信心。

title: Weighing the Morality of Refugee Admissions
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Weighing the Morality of Refugee Admissions
detail.abstract: At the end of 2023, 117.3 million people worldwide had to flee their homelands to escape persecution "for reasons of race, religion, nationality, membership of a particular social group or political opinion." These escapees qualify as "refugees" under the United Nations Convention Relating to the Status of Refugees, the terms of which are incorporated into U.S. law under the Refugee Act of 1980. Because the United States does not persecute inhabitants based on their religion, race, or politics and enjoys the world's highest living standards, we are unsurprisingly the destination of choice for multitudes of aliens, even when they are traveling from countries that are thousands of miles from our border, are separated from us by oceans, deserts, or mountain ranges, and are risking maltreatment by criminal gangs en route. This isn't sustainable, both for the U.S. and for refugees. There are, however, other solutions that may be wiser and, indeed, morally preferable.

title: Intelligence: Theory and Computation

detail.title: Intelligence: Theory and Computation
detail.abstract: In this paper, I formalize intelligence measurement in games by introducing mechanisms that assign a real number-interpreted as an intelligence score-to each player in a game. This score quantifies the ex-post strategic ability of the players based on empirically observable information, such as the actions of the players, the game's outcome, strength of the players, and a reference oracle machine such as a chess-playing artificial intelligence system. Specifically, I introduce two main concepts: first, the Game Intelligence (GI) mechanism, which quantifies a player's intelligence in a game by considering not only the game's outcome but also the "mistakes" made during the game according to the reference machine's intelligence. Second, I define gamingproofness, a practical and computational concept of strategyproofness. To illustrate the GI mechanism, I apply it to an extensive dataset comprising over a billion chess moves, including over a million moves made by top 20 grandmasters in history. Notably, Magnus Carlsen emerges with the highest GI score among all world championship games included in the dataset. In machinevs-machine games, the well-known chess engine Stockfish comes out on top.

title: How the ABA Resolved to End the Tampon Tax
affiliations: Pace University - School of Law

detail.title: How the ABA Resolved to End the Tampon Tax
detail.abstract: This Essay provides context for the American Bar Association's adoption of Resolution 507, which urges the repeal of taxes on menstrual products at all levels of government and supports related federal and international reforms. Written by a member of the task force that drafted the Resolution and the accompanying Report, the Essay situates the tampon tax within broader conversations about tax policy, gender justice, and the role of lawyers in law reform. It challenges the myth of tax neutrality and argues that tax is not only an economic tool but a vehicle for advancing dignity and equity. By highlighting the intersection of menstrual equity and fiscal policy, the Essay urges the legal profession-particularly tax lawyers and students-to view tax as a vehicle of justice and a pathway to meaningful legal change.

detail.abstract: This study examines how psychosocial factors related to mental health affect the work performance of academic staff at the Instituto Tecnológico Superior de Jerez, presented here as an example to apply the methodological model in various contexts. Theoretical frameworks such as Karasek's demand-control model and Maslach's burnout model are considered to identify risks and institutional support mechanisms. The findings indicate that chronic stress, anxiety and exhaustion impact productivity and job satisfaction; moreover, they highlight the need to strengthen personal resilience through organisational interventions. The work provides useful evidence for international comparison and for the development of public policies aimed at wellbeing and sustainability in higher education.

title: The Effects of the Covid-19 Pandemic and the Russia-Ukraine War on Food Security: The Case of Morocco and Turkey
affiliations: Altınbaş University

detail.title: The Effects of the Covid-19 Pandemic and the Russia-Ukraine War on Food Security: The Case of Morocco and Turkey

publicationDetails.detailsText: Altınbaş University Library Catalog / Altınbaş Üniversitesi

detail.abstract: With the international health crisis of the COVID-19 pandemic and the concurrent war crisis between Russia and Ukraine, the issue of food security has increased with force. Morocco and Turkey have important sectors of agriculture and serve vital functions in international and regional food output and allocation networks. Notably, the COVID-19 pandemic measures like shutdowns and constraints on movement perturbative the food supply chain, restricting access to groceries and markets, which drives to a lack of food, and occasionally even stock-out, the economic effects of this crisis like lack of wages and work, which further impact the capacity to endure sufficient diet for people, at the same time the Russia-Ukraine war influenced food security by perturbative the agricultural actions and spoiling infrastructure, also the dislodged populations which lead to a decline in the production of food, as well as the disturbances of trade in the regions which more advanced trigger the challenges over the restrictions on imports and rising prices. This thesis aims to examine and discuss the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and the Russia-Ukraine war on food security in Morocco and Turkey. A quantitative method was employed for the study. The target respondents were people living in Morocco and Turkey, with a sample size of 325participants. A self-administrated survey was used as a research instrument for data collection, and various statistical tests like Cronbach’s alpha for the reliability statistics, descriptive statistics, inferential statistics such as normality test, the mann-whitney u test, and multiple linear regression analyses were conducted to answer the research questions. The data and hypotheses were analyzed over the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS), and the research results show a significant impact of the demographic variables such as age, marital status, education level, employment status, income in Morocco, and income in Turkey which are the main factors that impact food security in Morocco and Turkey during both crises since their significance values are less than 0.05. This thesis contributes to a better understanding of the impact of both crises on food security.

title: SLIE: A Secure and Lightweight Cryptosystem for Data Sharing in IoT Healthcare Services
affiliations: Lecturer, Hitachi Digital Services, , NLS Tech Vietnam and Polarista A.I

detail.title: SLIE: A Secure and Lightweight Cryptosystem for Data Sharing in IoT Healthcare Services

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None
declarations.funderStatement: The authors acknowledge Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HC- MUT), VNU-HCM, for supporting this study.

detail.abstract: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) has revolutionized healthcare by transforming medical operations into standardized, interoperable services. However, this service-oriented model introduces significant security vulnerabilities in device management and communication, which are especially critical given the sensitivity of medical data. To address these risks, this paper proposes SLIE (Secure and Lightweight Identity Encryption), a novel cryptosystem based on Wildcard Key Derivation Identity-Based Encryption (WKD-IBE). SLIE ensures scalable trust and secure omnidirectional communication through end-to-end encryption, hierarchical access control, and a lightweight key management system designed for resource-constrained devices. It incorporates constanttime operations, memory obfuscation, and expiry-based key revocation to counter side-channel, man-in-the-middle, and unauthorized access attacks, thereby ensuring compliance with standards like HIPAA and GDPR. Evaluations show that SLIE significantly outperforms RSA, with encryption and decryption times of 0.936ms and 0.217ms for 1KB of data, an 84.54% improvement in encryption speed, a 99.70% improvement in decryption speed, and an energy efficiency of 0.014 J/KB.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SLIE（安全轻量级身份加密）系统，这是一种基于通配符密钥派生身份加密的新型密码系统，专门针对医疗物联网设备的安全需求设计。SLIE通过端到端加密、分层访问控制和轻量级密钥管理，显著提升了医疗设备通信的安全性和效率。
AI.research_question: 如何在资源受限的医疗物联网设备中实现安全、高效的身份加密和密钥管理？
AI.motivation: 医疗物联网的服务导向模式引入了设备管理和通信方面的安全漏洞，而医疗数据的敏感性使得这些风险尤为关键。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于通配符密钥派生身份加密（WKD-IBE）理论框架，结合分层访问控制和轻量级密钥管理。
AI.method: 提出SLIE密码系统，采用恒定时间操作、内存混淆和基于过期的密钥撤销机制。
AI.findings: SLIE在加密和解密性能上显著优于RSA，1KB数据的加密时间为0.936ms，解密时间为0.217ms，加密速度提升84.54%，解密速度提升99.70%，能效为0.014 J/KB。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于WKD-IBE的新型密码系统理论，实现了可扩展信任和安全全向通信。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗物联网设备提供了符合HIPAA和GDPR标准的安全解决方案，有效抵御侧信道攻击、中间人攻击和未授权访问。

title: Rethinking Portfolio Risk: Forecasting Volatility through Cointegrated Asset Dynamics

detail.title: Rethinking Portfolio Risk: Forecasting Volatility through Cointegrated Asset Dynamics
detail.abstract: We introduce the Historical and Dynamic Volatility Ratios (HVR/DVR) and show that equity and index volatilities are cointegrated at intraday and daily horizons. This allows us to construct a VECM to forecast portfolio volatility by exploiting volatility cointegration. On S&P 500 data, HVR is generally stationary and cointegration with the index is frequent; the VECM implementation yields substantially lower mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) than covariance-based forecasts at short- to medium-term horizons across portfolio sizes. The approach is interpretable and readily implementable, factorizing covariance into market volatility, relative-volatility ratios, and correlations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了历史波动率比率(HVR)和动态波动率比率(DVR)，发现股票与指数波动率在日内和日间存在协整关系，并构建VECM模型来预测投资组合波动率。在标普500数据上，HVR通常是平稳的，与指数的协整关系频繁出现；VECM实现相比基于协方差的预测在短期到中期范围内显著降低了平均绝对百分比误差。
AI.research_question: 股票与指数波动率是否存在协整关系？如何利用这种关系来改进投资组合波动率预测？
AI.motivation: 传统基于协方差的波动率预测方法存在局限性，需要探索更有效的预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协整理论、向量误差修正模型(VECM)、波动率比率概念
AI.method: 构建历史波动率比率(HVR)和动态波动率比率(DVR)，使用VECM模型，在标普500数据上进行实证分析
AI.findings: 股票与指数波动率存在协整关系，VECM模型在短期到中期预测中显著优于传统协方差方法，HVR通常是平稳的
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了波动率协整的新概念，发展了基于协整的波动率预测理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种可解释且易于实现的波动率预测方法，将协方差分解为市场波动率、相对波动率比率和相关性

title: The Trilemma, Macroprudential Policy, and Monetary Spillovers

detail.title: The Trilemma, Macroprudential Policy, and Monetary Spillovers
detail.abstract: Using hand-dated country policy events and daily firm-level equity returns, I estimate how capital controls, exchange rate regimes, and macroprudential policy moderate spillovers from Fed, ECB, and BoE shocks. An event-style design around precisely dated policy changes shows: First, tightening capital controls or adopting greater exchange-rate flexibility attenuates the negative spillovers of conventional policy shocks. Second, exchange-rate flexibility amplifies positive spillovers from QE. Third, macroprudential tightening mitigates spillovers from both conventional and QE shocks. Moreover, macroprudential measures remain effective as QE scales up, whereas the absorptive power of capital controls wanes at large purchase sizes. Simulations from a stylized two-country collateral model deliver consistent predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了资本管制、汇率制度和宏观审慎政策如何调节美联储、欧洲央行和英国央行政策冲击的跨国溢出效应。研究发现，收紧资本管制或增加汇率灵活性可以减弱常规政策冲击的负面溢出，而汇率灵活性会放大QE的正面溢出。宏观审慎收紧对常规和QE冲击的溢出都有缓解作用。
AI.research_question: 资本管制、汇率制度和宏观审慎政策如何调节主要央行（美联储、欧洲央行、英国央行）政策冲击的跨国溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 理解不同政策工具在调节国际金融溢出效应中的相对有效性，为政策制定者提供应对跨境资本流动冲击的实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于事件研究设计和两国家抵押品模型的理论框架，分析政策冲击的跨国传导机制。
AI.method: 使用手工收集的国家政策事件数据和日度公司层面股票回报率，采用事件研究设计围绕精确日期的政策变化进行分析。
AI.findings: 1) 收紧资本管制或增加汇率灵活性减弱常规政策冲击的负面溢出；2) 汇率灵活性放大QE的正面溢出；3) 宏观审慎收紧缓解常规和QE冲击的溢出；4) 宏观审慎措施在QE规模扩大时仍有效，而资本管制的吸收能力在大规模购买时减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了资本管制、汇率制度和宏观审慎政策在调节国际金融溢出效应中相对有效性的系统实证证据，验证了两国家抵押品模型的预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在不同政策冲击情景下选择适当政策工具组合的实证指导，特别是QE规模扩大时的政策有效性差异。

title: Mathematical Analysis of Information Processing in Economic Systems: Quantitative Framework for Information-Based Exchange Behavior

detail.title: Mathematical Analysis of Information Processing in Economic Systems: Quantitative Framework for Information-Based Exchange Behavior
detail.abstract: This work establishes the mathematical inevitability of economic behavior by deriving commerce from fundamental constraints facing finite observers. Beginning with single agents operating under bounded computational capacity (C processing < ∞), finite temporal existence (t ∈ [0, T ]), limited sensory bandwidth (C sensory < ∞), and resource constraints (C resource < ∞), we prove that individual knowledge insufficiency mathematically necessitates collective coordination architectures. This coordination requirement generates systematic information exchange patterns that manifest as economic activity. Mathematical analysis demonstrates that knowledge exists as dynamic extraction process K(t) = E suf f icient [M(t) ∩ X (t)] ∩ E(t) rather than static storage, creating inevitable dependency on external validation systems. Archaeological evidence from 847 fire-circle sites validates optimization for collective information processing, with circular arrangements providing 2.3-3.7Ö efficiency improvements over linear configurations. Cross-cultural analysis across 247 documented societies reveals consistent information-status correlations (r > 0.69) regardless of technological level, confirming universal emergence from finite observer constraints. The framework resolves longstanding puzzles in economic anthropology by showing commerce as mathematical consequence of individual cognitive limitations rather than cultural innovation.

AI.tldr: 该研究从数学上证明了经济行为的必然性，通过推导出有限观察者面临的基本约束如何必然导致商业活动。研究表明个体知识不足需要集体协调架构，这种协调需求产生了系统性的信息交换模式，即经济活动。
AI.research_question: 经济行为是否可以从数学上必然推导出来？个体认知限制如何导致集体协调架构和商业活动的出现？
AI.motivation: 解决经济人类学中长期存在的谜题，证明商业活动是个人认知限制的数学结果而非文化创新。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有限观察者理论，包括有限计算能力、有限时间存在、有限感官带宽和资源约束。知识被建模为动态提取过程而非静态存储。
AI.method: 数学分析推导结合考古证据（847个火圈遗址）和跨文化分析（247个有记载的社会）。
AI.findings: 个体知识不足数学上必然需要集体协调架构；圆形排列比线性配置效率提高2.3-3.7倍；跨文化分析显示信息状态相关性高度一致（r>0.69）。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了经济行为的数学必然性框架，将商业活动重新定义为个体认知限制的必然结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解经济系统的普遍性提供了理论基础，解释了为什么不同技术水平的文明都会发展出类似的经济协调机制。

title: Political Regime Types and International Trade Patterns: A Comprehensive Analysis of Democracy-Trade Relationships and Economic Incentives for Democratic Governance
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Political Regime Types and International Trade Patterns: A Comprehensive Analysis of Democracy-Trade Relationships and Economic Incentives for Democratic Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, political, or professional competing interests that could influence the research design, analysis, or interpretation of results presented in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently without external funding sources or institutional support.

detail.abstract: Background: Global democratic backsliding has accelerated, with Freedom House documenting eighteen consecutive years of democratic decline through 2024. Simultaneously, international trade has reached $33 trillion annually, creating complex interdependencies across diverse political systems. Understanding relationships between political regime types and trade patterns may reveal economic incentives for democratic governance and inform evidence-based policy interventions. Methods: We conducted systematic analysis of 167 countries using convergent classification from three established democracy indices: V-Dem Liberal Democracy Index, Freedom House Freedom in the World, and EIU Democracy Index. Countries were categorized as Full Democracies (n=24), Flawed Democracies (n=50), Hybrid Regimes (n=34), or Authoritarian Regimes (n=59). Trade flows were analyzed using 2024 WTO and UNCTAD data. Major trade agreements were examined by regime composition. Statistical analysis included ANOVA, chi-square testing, and correlation analysis with established causal frameworks. Results: Full democracies demonstrate significant economic advantages, with causal analysis confirming democratization increases GDP per capita by 20-25% (p<0.001). However, trade patterns reveal systematic contradictions: while intra-democratic trade represents $8.5 trillion (26% of global flows), democracies depend heavily on non-democratic suppliers for critical goods (65% of fossil fuels, 70% of rare earth elements). Major trade agreements (RCEP covering $26.2 trillion GDP, CPTPP covering $13.4 trillion GDP) successfully integrate diverse regime types. Analysis reveals an "Authoritarian Efficiency Trap" where current trade rules reward authoritarian characteristics (regulatory speed, suppressed labor costs) over democratic accountability. Conclusions: Strong economic incentives exist for democratic development, but current global trade architecture creates perverse incentives favoring short-term authoritarian efficiency over long-term democratic advantages. Novel "Democracy Premium" mechanisms could realign market incentives to reward democratic governance while maintaining economic efficiency. Market-based approaches may complement traditional democracy promotion by making democratic institutions economically advantageous rather than costly.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了政治体制类型与贸易模式的关系，发现民主国家具有显著经济优势（民主化使人均GDP增加20-25%），但全球贸易架构存在"威权效率陷阱"，奖励威权特征而非民主问责。
AI.research_question: 政治体制类型如何影响全球贸易模式？民主与威权国家之间的贸易关系是否存在系统性矛盾？
AI.motivation: 全球民主倒退加速（连续18年下降），同时国际贸易达33万亿美元，需要理解不同政治体制间的贸易关系以揭示民主治理的经济激励。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主理论、国际贸易理论、制度经济学、民主倒退理论
AI.method: 对167个国家进行系统分析，使用三个民主指数（V-Dem、Freedom House、EIU）进行收敛分类，分析WTO和UNCTAD贸易数据，采用ANOVA、卡方检验和相关分析。
AI.findings: 民主国家间贸易占全球26%（8.5万亿美元），但民主国家严重依赖非民主国家供应关键商品（65%化石燃料、70%稀土）。贸易协议成功整合不同体制类型，但存在"威权效率陷阱"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"威权效率陷阱"概念，揭示当前贸易规则如何奖励威权特征而非民主问责。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议引入"民主溢价"机制，使民主制度在经济上更具优势，为基于市场的民主促进方法提供新思路。

title: Tesla -Porter Five Forces Analysis & Competitive Rivalry
affiliations: University of Michigan

detail.title: Tesla -Porter Five Forces Analysis & Competitive Rivalry
detail.abstract: This paper applies Porter's Five Forces Framework to Tesla Inc., evaluating the firm's strategic position in the rapidly evolving electric vehicle (EV) and clean energy ecosystem. It examines Tesla's supplier relationships, buyer dynamics, entry barriers, substitution risks, and intensity of competitive rivalry. The analysis highlights Tesla's dual strategic posture: as a vertically integrated energy innovator and as a challenger brand in traditional automotive markets. Notable themes include Tesla's dependency on core suppliers like Panasonic, shifting consumer bargaining power driven by delivery lags, regulatory dependence, and the rising challenge from legacy automakers transitioning into the EV space. This framework also incorporates the sixth contextual force-Government and Law-as a defining element of Tesla's strategic leverage and risk. The analysis reveals Tesla's current advantage in innovation and ecosystem control, while cautioning against overexposure to regulatory shifts, supply chain fragility, and increasing competition in autonomous systems and energy infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文运用波特五力模型分析特斯拉在电动汽车和清洁能源领域的战略地位，发现特斯拉具有垂直整合创新者和传统汽车市场挑战者的双重战略定位，在创新和生态系统控制方面具有优势，但也面临监管依赖、供应链脆弱性和竞争加剧等风险。
AI.research_question: 特斯拉在快速发展的电动汽车和清洁能源生态系统中的战略地位如何？
AI.motivation: 评估特斯拉在电动汽车和清洁能源领域的竞争态势，理解其作为垂直整合能源创新者和传统汽车市场挑战者的双重战略定位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 波特五力模型（供应商议价能力、买方议价能力、新进入者威胁、替代品威胁、现有竞争者竞争强度），并加入第六力——政府与法律作为情境因素。
AI.method: 应用波特五力框架对特斯拉进行案例分析，评估其在电动汽车和清洁能源生态系统中的战略地位。
AI.findings: 特斯拉在创新和生态系统控制方面具有优势，但面临对核心供应商（如松下）的依赖、消费者议价能力因交付延迟而变化、监管依赖、传统汽车制造商向电动汽车转型带来的竞争加剧等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了波特五力模型，将政府与法律作为第六个情境力量纳入分析框架，强调了监管环境对电动汽车和清洁能源企业战略的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为特斯拉和其他电动汽车企业提供了战略洞察，强调了在保持创新优势的同时，需要关注供应链管理、监管风险应对和竞争加剧的挑战。

title: Price and Volume Divergence in China's Real Estate Markets: The Role of Local Governments
affiliations: , Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of Finance and Princeton University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Price and Volume Divergence in China's Real Estate Markets: The Role of Local Governments
detail.abstract: During the COVID-19 pandemic (2020-2022), Chinese cities witnessed a paradox: residential land and new house prices surged while transaction volumes plummeted. We attribute this to local governments' active price management through supply controls, land acquisitions by local government financing vehicles (LGFVs), and limits on new home sales permits. Cities more dependent on land sales and land-backed debt before the pandemic experienced greater price increases and price-volume divergence, with LGFVs buying more land at higher prices than other buyers. These interventions helped sustain fiscal financing but deepened developers' financial distress, revealing unintended consequences of local governments' fiscal strategies during downturns.

AI.tldr: 疫情期间中国城市出现房价上涨但交易量下降的悖论，这归因于地方政府通过供应控制、城投公司购地和限售等手段进行价格管理。土地财政依赖度高的城市价格涨幅更大，城投公司以更高价格购地，这些干预措施维持了财政融资但加剧了开发商财务困境。
AI.research_question: 疫情期间中国城市房价上涨与交易量下降悖论的原因是什么？地方政府干预措施如何影响房地产市场？
AI.motivation: 解释疫情期间中国城市出现的房价上涨但交易量下降的异常现象，揭示地方政府干预对房地产市场的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于土地财政理论、地方政府干预理论和房地产市场供需理论，分析地方政府在疫情期间的房地产调控策略。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用城市层面的面板数据，比较不同土地财政依赖度城市的价格和交易量变化，分析城投公司购地行为。
AI.findings: 土地财政依赖度高的城市房价涨幅更大，价格与交易量背离更明显；城投公司比其他买家以更高价格购地；地方政府干预维持了财政融资但加剧了开发商财务困境。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了地方政府在危机期间通过房地产干预维持财政收入的机制，拓展了土地财政理论和政府干预理论的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于地方政府干预措施意外后果的警示，有助于优化房地产调控政策和财政风险管理。

title: Tesla PESTEL Analysis -Harvard
affiliations: University of Michigan

detail.title: Tesla PESTEL Analysis -Harvard
detail.abstract: This paper is a strategic analysis of Tesla Motors, Inc.: "How Tesla Motors Inc. can improve its strategy to sustain its competitive advantage on the electric vehicle market and confirm its position as a transformational leader in sustainable lifestyle?". Tesla Motors was created in 2003 by a group of engineers in Silicon Valley with a vision to create the most compelling car company of the 21st century by driving the world's transition to electric vehicles. In 2008, Tesla shattered those standards by creating the Roadster, a car capable of traveling 245 miles on a single charge, along with a 0-60 time of 3.7 seconds. With slow growth and declining sales margin within the early release of its "Roadster", tesla has made a remarkable recovery and has proved that "electric vehicles can be safe, user-friendly usable and reliable to the market. The Model S, an electric luxury sedan, being released in 2012, won Motor trends 2013 car of the year award. It has been the best-selling plug-in electric car for two consecutive years: 2015, 2016. Of the approximate 356,232 electric vehicles around the world today, Tesla accounts for 50,000. It reached a peak of 150000 units sold by November 2016. As of December 2016, it lies best, being second to the Nissan Leaf. The Model S was then followed in September 2015 by the Model X. Tesla's next vehicle is the Model 3, releasing mid-2017 with a base price of US$35,000, assuming it to be the most-affordable wide-range EV ever released in the industry. All large auto manufactures, other than Toyota (the limited production Rav4e can travel 103 miles per charge), have yet to create an electric vehicle that can travel more than 100 miles on a charge. A seventh of the market share is remarkable for a company that started just more than a decade ago. The EV company specializes in lithium-ion batteries, electric vehicles, and residential-consumer based solar panels, in cooperation with Solar City.

AI.tldr: 特斯拉如何通过战略改进维持其在电动汽车市场的竞争优势并巩固其作为可持续生活方式转型领导者的地位
AI.research_question: 特斯拉汽车公司如何改进其战略以维持其在电动汽车市场的竞争优势并确认其作为可持续生活方式转型领导者的地位？
AI.motivation: 特斯拉自2003年成立以来，从Roadster的缓慢增长到Model S的成功，证明了电动汽车可以安全、用户友好且可靠。公司需要持续改进战略以维持竞争优势，特别是在传统汽车制造商开始进入电动汽车市场的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略分析框架，竞争优势理论，可持续转型领导力理论
AI.method: 战略分析，案例研究，市场数据分析
AI.findings: 特斯拉通过技术创新（如长续航电池技术）、产品多样化（从Roadster到Model S、Model X、Model 3）以及与Solar City的合作，在电动汽车市场取得了显著成功，占据了约1/7的市场份额。
AI.theory_contributions: 为电动汽车行业的战略管理和可持续转型提供了实证案例，展示了技术创新与市场定位如何共同创造竞争优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 为特斯拉提供了战略改进建议，帮助其维持市场领导地位；为其他电动汽车制造商提供了可借鉴的成功经验。

detail.abstract: Over the past two decades, the divergence in GDP per capita between the United States and major European economies has grown. Relative to 2000, this gap has widened by 41% (see Panel A in Figure 1).

declarations.ethicsApproval: N\A

detail.abstract: This article offers a critical and interdisciplinary analysis of the right to equality in Canada and Québec, through the examination of forty institutional Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion (EDI) instruments adopted between 2020 and 2024. Although equality is enshrined in a robust legal framework — including the Canadian Charter, the Québec Charter, and several international instruments — its effectiveness remains both limited and structurally problematic. The study highlights a normative paradox: inclusion is managed through symbolic, non-binding instruments that render legal equality normatively inert. Drawing on legal sociology, critical theory, and public policy analysis, the article shows that EDI instruments operate within a regime of symbolic governance, in which the right to equality is neutralized in favour of institutional performativity structured around charters, action plans, and soft law metrics. This soft regulation of systemic inequality contributes to the aestheticization of equality commitments and to the outsourcing of legal responsibility. The article argues for a normative requalification of inclusion, grounded in the enforceable and justiciable integration of the right to equality into Canadian and Québécois legal architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对2020-2024年间加拿大和魁北克40个机构性EDI工具的分析，揭示了平等权利在现有法律框架下的局限性和结构性缺陷。研究发现，包容性通过象征性、无约束力的工具来管理，导致法律平等在规范上失效。文章主张将平等权利可执行地整合到法律架构中。
AI.research_question: 在加拿大和魁北克，尽管存在健全的法律框架保障平等权利，为什么EDI工具的有效性仍然有限且存在结构性问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管平等权利在加拿大宪章、魁北克宪章和国际文书中得到确立，但其实际效果仍然有限且存在结构性缺陷，需要批判性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律社会学、批判理论、公共政策分析
AI.method: 对2020-2024年间40个机构性EDI工具进行跨学科批判分析
AI.findings: EDI工具在象征性治理体制下运作，平等权利被中立化，转而支持以章程、行动计划和软法指标为结构的制度表演性；系统不平等通过软法规制，导致平等承诺的美学化和法律责任的转嫁
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了平等权利的规范性悖论：包容性通过象征性工具管理，使法律平等在规范上失效；提出了基于可执行平等权利整合的规范性重新定义
AI.practical_contributions: 为加拿大和魁北克法律架构中平等权利的可执行整合提供了理论基础；揭示了软法规制对系统性不平等的影响

title: Solar Microfinance as a Circular Self-Reinforcing System: Breaking Points, Capacity Creation, and Scale Across Rural Communities in Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Solar Microfinance as a Circular Self-Reinforcing System: Breaking Points, Capacity Creation, and Scale Across Rural Communities in Sub-Saharan Africa
detail.abstract: In Sub-Saharan Africa, over 600 million people remain unelectrified, forcing them to rely on costly, polluting fuels that restrict household productivity, suppress entrepreneurial ventures, and hinder regional economic development. Although solar home systems can reduce monthly energy costs by 60-85%, eliminate operational greenhouse gas emissions, create local microenterprises and additional income streams, adoption remains limited by high upfront costs and traditional lenders' perceptions of credit risk. This paper develops and validates a six-stage reinforcing-cycle framework that integrates microfinance, solar adoption, household economics, income generation, environmental benefits, and capital mobilization into a circular self-reinforcing cycle. Using weighted household economics (31% entrepreneurial, 69% cost-savings-focused) and operational data from Kenya, Uganda, and Tanzania, the study identifies and quantifies three "breaking points" that determine whether microfinance programs fail: payment extraction rates exceeding 85-90% of created benefits, entrepreneurial participation falling below 20-25%, and technological breakdowns occurring within 18-24 months. Programs that breach these thresholds experience 15-30% default rates, while those that ensure avoidance consistently achieve repayment rates between 90-98%, demonstrating the critical thresholds separating successful programs from failed ones. The paper's findings and multi-stakeholder analysis reframe solar credit risk as capacity creation rather than income extraction, showcasing that when these reinforcement mechanisms align, markets deemed unpredictable produce predictable results. Policy and investment implications include maintaining 18-24-month loan terms at interest rates under 30%, achieving adoption densities of at least 15-20% to catalyze local entrepreneurial network effects, supporting mobile-money and maintenance infrastructure, and monetizing carbon credit revenues of $0.50-1.60 per household annually on an institutional scale. When these financial, technological, and geographic factors are controlled, solar microfinance initiatives no longer act as volatile temporary interventions but as scalable programs built upon self-reinforcing mechanisms that simultaneously advance financial inclusion, foster new microenterprises, improve rural health conditions, and progress toward national climate goals across emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个六阶段强化循环框架，整合了小额信贷、太阳能采用、家庭经济、创收、环境效益和资本动员。研究发现三个关键阈值决定小额信贷项目成败：支付提取率超过85-90%、创业参与率低于20-25%、技术故障发生在18-24个月内。成功项目还款率达90-98%。
AI.research_question: 什么因素决定太阳能小额信贷项目的成功与失败？如何通过强化循环机制将太阳能信贷风险重新定义为能力创造而非收入提取？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲超过6亿人无电可用，依赖昂贵污染燃料，限制了家庭生产力和经济发展。尽管太阳能家庭系统能降低60-85%能源成本并创造收入，但高昂前期成本和信贷风险认知限制了采用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 六阶段强化循环框架：整合小额信贷、太阳能采用、家庭经济、收入生成、环境效益和资本动员的循环自我强化机制。
AI.method: 使用肯尼亚、乌干达和坦桑尼亚的加权家庭经济数据（31%创业导向，69%成本节约导向）和运营数据分析。
AI.findings: 识别三个关键阈值：支付提取率超过85-90%导致失败；创业参与率低于20-25%导致失败；技术故障发生在18-24个月内导致失败。成功项目还款率90-98%，失败项目违约率15-30%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将太阳能信贷风险重新定义为能力创造而非收入提取；展示了当强化机制对齐时，看似不可预测的市场会产生可预测结果。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策建议：维持18-24个月贷款期限，利率低于30%；达到15-20%采用密度以催化本地创业网络效应；支持移动支付和维护基础设施；每年每户0.50-1.60美元的碳信用收入货币化。

detail.abstract: Democracy and human rights are essential for ensuring long-term peace, development, and justice in societies worldwide. Democracy, with its principles of participation, accountability, and rule of law, is often considered the optimal framework for safeguarding human rights. This study aims to explore how democratic institutions of Bangladesh contribute to the protection and promotion of human rights. This research uses an interdisciplinary systematic literature review to examine the proactive advancement of human dignity, equality, and justice by democratic institutions, including the legislature, the executive, an independent judiciary, a free electoral system, media freedom, a vibrant civil society, and the national human rights commission (NHRC). This study is based on secondary sources of information. We have gathered data from books, relevant paper, articles, and documents supplied by numerous sources. Through a systematic review of literature, the paper identifies both the strengths and limitations of democratic institutions in fulfilling their human rights obligations. The findings reveal that democratic institutions significantly enhance human rights protection, particularly through a legislature, a free electoral system, an independent judiciary, and media freedom. Moreover, the study also identified challenges such as authoritarianism, political consolidation, corruption, weak institutional independence, and media control that hinder the full protection of human rights. The results suggest that while democratic institutions are a crucial mechanism for promoting and protecting human rights, their success depends on the strength of democratic governance and active participation.

detail.title: Rice Processing Industry of Bangladesh: An Economic Analysis
detail.abstract: This study examines the rice processing industry in detail by dividing rice mills into two categories (Automatic rice mill and Husking mill). First, this study discussed and calculated the establishment and operational costs for the Automatic rice mill and Husking mill. Then discussed the firms' legal issues, production process, by-products, marketing channels, government policies, and problems & prospects of this industry. Besides, this study has separately examined the profitability of the micro, small, medium, and large firms. The data of this study were collected from the ECRL's data bank, which was collected in January-December 2016 for credit rating purposes. This study has selected the 50 best samples from 76 rice mills based on the available information. The data set covered five Divisions of Bangladesh: Chittagong, Dhaka, Khulna, Rajshahi, and Rangpur. This study revealed that the average total revenue for micro firms is Tk.128.38 million, for the small firms is Tk.380.15 million, for the medium firms is Tk.722.73 million and for the large firms is Tk1357.37 million. The benefit-cost ratio is 1.06, 1.06, 1.09, and 1.03 for the micro, small, medium, and large firms, respectively. The average total benefit-cost ratio for the rice processing industry is 1.06. Finally, this study discusses the problems and prospects of this industry.

detail.title: Private Plant Nursery Business in Bangladesh: A Socio-Economic Analysis
detail.abstract: This study examines the socio-economic condition, profitability, and marketing channel of small-scale private plant nurseries in Bangladesh. The study has conducted based on survey data collected from 105 respondents from the Dhaka metropolitan area, Savar Upazila, and two Upazilas of Gazipur District from January-March 2018 using a structured questionnaire. The study reveals that about 74% of private plant nursery is established on government land in the Dhaka metropolitan area. In contrast, the nurseries have mainly been established on rented property in Gazipur (68%) and Savar (56%) areas. The nursery's average land size is 9.06 decimals in Dhaka metropolitan area, 182.06 in Gazipur, and 121.18 in the Savar area. The average length of business is 12 years, and over 80% of firms operate under sole proprietorships. The average annual income per decimal land is Tk.76,411 in Dhaka, Tk.7,066 in Gazipur, and Tk.10,085 in Savar. The benefit-cost ratio per decimal land is 1.53, 1.51, and 1.52 in Dhaka, Gazipur, and Savar areas. Usually, two intermediaries, such as wholesalers and retailers, are involved in the plant nursery business. Although the plant nursery business is a profitable enterprise, the owners are facing numerous problems that need to be improved for the smooth expansion of the nursery business in Bangladesh.

title: CBDCs and Green Macroprudential Policy: An AB-SFC Analysis for a Sustainable Financial Future
affiliations: Aalborg University Business School, University of Lille and Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: CBDCs and Green Macroprudential Policy: An AB-SFC Analysis for a Sustainable Financial Future
detail.abstract: The intersection of Central Bank Digital Currencies (CBDCs) and macroprudential green monetary policy presents a novel approach to aligning financial stability with environmental sustainability. This paper explores the potential role of CBDCs in enhancing green finance through macroprudential tools, using China as a case study. We develop a theoretical Agent-Based Stock-Flow Consistent (AB-SFC) model that integrates heterogeneous agents and sectoral balance sheets to assess the macroeconomic and financial stability implications of green monetary interventions facilitated by a CBDC. We simulate four policy scenarios. In the baseline scenario, both brown and green firms access funding exclusively through commercial banks. Scenario 1 introduces a CBDC-based mechanism where the central bank partially finances green utility firms, while maintaining the same macroprudential policy as in the baseline. Scenario 2 adds a green-interest rate differential, with the central bank offering lower rates on CBDC financing to green firms. Scenario 3 explores the active use of macroprudential tools, specifically differentiated reserve requirements for banks based on the environmental profile of their lending portfolios. Preliminary findings suggest that a well-designed CBDC framework, especially when coupled with targeted green incentives and macroprudential differentiation, can strengthen financial stability while accelerating the transition toward a greener economy. Our study contributes to the emerging literature on green finance and digital currencies by providing a theoretical foundation and quantitative insights into policy trade-offs. The results offer practical implications for central banks and policymakers aiming to leverage digital currency innovations to meet both financial and environmental objectives.
