detail.abstract: By 2024, TikTok and its Chinese counterpart Douyin reached 2.6 billion users worldwide, each spending on average 52 minutes per day on these platforms. This paper provides the first large-scale causal evidence on how short-video platforms affect mental health taking China-the world's largest and most mature market-as the case study. We combine citylevel data on app usage time with longitudinal survey data (2010-2022) and exploit spatial variation in pre-2016 4G infrastructure, interacted with individuals' prior internet use and the timing of Douyin's 2016 launch, to instrument for exposure. We confirm that a tenpercentage-point increase in city-level short-video time share reduces mental health by 0.4 standard deviations among pre-2016 mobile internet users-about 80% as large as the effect of unemployment. Adverse impacts are more severe among vulnerable groups: youth, elderly, rural, poor, and less-educated individuals, with the left-behind elderly most affected. Mechanism analysis highlights four channels: unfavorable social comparison and heightened inequality perception; disrupted sleep and exercise; declining physical, cognitive, and noncognitive health; and weakened interpersonal relationships, particularly between adults and their parents/children, suggesting potential spillovers beyond primary users. These findings underscore how digital innovation can exacerbate mental health disparities across social groups through multiple channels.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次提供了短视频平台对心理健康影响的大规模因果证据。研究发现，城市层面短视频使用时间占比每增加10个百分点，会使2016年前移动互联网用户的心理健康水平下降0.4个标准差，影响程度约为失业影响的80%。弱势群体（青年、老年人、农村、贫困和低教育水平人群）受到的影响更严重。
AI.research_question: 短视频平台如何影响用户的心理健康？
AI.motivation: 截至2024年，TikTok及其中国版抖音全球用户达26亿，平均每天使用52分钟。需要了解这些平台对心理健康的因果影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用2016年前4G基础设施的空间差异，结合个人先前的互联网使用情况和抖音2016年上线时间作为工具变量。
AI.method: 结合城市层面的应用使用时间数据和纵向调查数据（2010-2022），利用空间变异构建工具变量分析。
AI.findings: 短视频使用增加显著降低心理健康水平，弱势群体受影响更严重。影响机制包括：不利的社会比较和加剧的不平等感知；睡眠和锻炼被打乱；身体、认知和非认知健康下降；人际关系弱化，特别是成年人与父母/子女的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供短视频平台对心理健康影响的因果证据，揭示了数字创新如何通过多种渠道加剧心理健康不平等。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据，帮助识别和干预受数字平台负面影响最大的弱势群体，促进更健康的数字环境建设。

title: Constraint-Aware Self-Improving Large Language Model for Clinical Role Model Generation
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology - The H. Milton Stewart School of Industrial & Systems Engineering (ISyE), Mays Business School, Texas A&M University and

detail.title: Constraint-Aware Self-Improving Large Language Model for Clinical Role Model Generation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors acknowledge there are no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The data used in this research was approved under IRB 2022-1303 by Texas A&M University and under IRB H22333 by Georgia Institute of Technology.
declarations.funderStatement: There is no funding for this research.

detail.abstract: Personalized medicine uses Clinical Role Models (CRMs)-individuals with similar health profiles-to build patient trust. However, CRM identification is challenged by data scarcity and privacy constraints. While Medical Large Language Models (MLLMs) can synthesize CRMs, they risk generating invalid "hallucinations" and face inconsistencies from evolving risk-scoring tools. We propose CASE (Constraint-Aware active SElfimproving fine-tuning), which integrates data-driven optimization with MLLM's generative capabilities to produce reliable CRMs. CASE employs a robust-optimization-based verifier to ensure CRMs are clinically valid, meeting patient requirements and reducing risk. Verified examples are then used to fine-tune the MLLM in a self-improving loop. We developed an active learning algorithm with utility-driven sampling and provide rigorous theoretical guarantees including high-probability sublinear regrets of the learning algorithm and patient safety guarantees of CASE. From clinical and survey data, we found that generated CRMs outperform real CRMs by >130% in reliability and 23% in Effort-to-Change reduction. We also found that a clear learning signal determines the outcomes of the fine-tuned model. Our work presents a novel integration of data-driven optimization and generative AI to enhance trust and decision-making in personalized medicine.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CASE方法，通过结合数据驱动优化和医疗大语言模型生成能力，解决临床角色模型识别中的数据稀缺和隐私问题，生成可靠且临床有效的角色模型。
AI.research_question: 如何解决个性化医疗中临床角色模型识别面临的数据稀缺、隐私约束以及大语言模型生成无效内容的问题？
AI.motivation: 个性化医疗需要临床角色模型来建立患者信任，但现有方法面临数据稀缺、隐私限制以及大语言模型生成无效内容的风险。

AI.method: CASE方法：使用鲁棒优化验证器确保临床角色模型的临床有效性，通过主动学习算法进行效用驱动采样，并在自我改进循环中微调大语言模型。
AI.findings: 生成的临床角色模型在可靠性上比真实模型提升超过130%，在改变努力度上减少23%；明确的学习信号决定了微调模型的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合数据驱动优化和生成式AI的新框架，提供了学习算法的高概率次线性遗憾和患者安全保障的理论保证。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个性化医疗提供了可靠且临床有效的临床角色模型生成方法，增强了患者信任和决策支持。

title: Lebanon, If Connected: A Magnet for Digital Nomads
affiliations: Tokyo University of Foreign Studies

detail.title: Lebanon, If Connected: A Magnet for Digital Nomads
detail.abstract: Lebanon’s struggle with electricity shortages, fragile connectivity, and systemic uncertainty has long constrained its economic promise. Yet these same challenges have also revealed a culture of improvisation and endurance that mirrors the global ethos of digital nomadism. “Lebanon, If Connected: A Magnet for Digital Nomads” reframes the country’s infrastructural fragility as a site of resilience and potential policy innovation. Through the lens of remote work, it examines how informal collaboration, shared resources, and adaptive communities sustain daily life and could form the foundation for a new digital economy. The essay argues that if Lebanon transforms connection from improvisation into coherent policy—combining power stability, transparent e-visa systems, and reliable broadband—it could attract global digital nomads while re-engaging its own diaspora. Ultimately, the piece positions connectivity as both a human and national metaphor: where scarcity fosters ingenuity, and adaptation itself becomes Lebanon’s most valuable signal to the world.

publicationDetails.journalName: United States Association for Energy Economics (USAEE) & International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: A ten-equation DSGE model is designed to capture household optimization, firm production decisions, environmental dynamics, and banking sector vulnerabilities during Net Zero Emission transition periods. It is calibrated to Polish macroeconomic data from 2000-2019 to evaluate various policy scenarios, including gradual versus rapid carbon tax implementation and different emission reduction targets. Results highlight critical trade-offs among environmental goals, economic stability, and financial system resilience. The analysis shows that Poland can reach its net-zero emissions target while maintaining macroeconomic stability through coordinated policy measures, with productivity gains generating positive spillovers across the economy. This study addresses significant gaps in environmental macroeconomic modelling for Central and Eastern European contexts, providing new insights for Poland's EU-mandated decarbonization policy while preserving economic and financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个十方程DSGE模型，模拟波兰在净零排放转型期间的家庭优化、企业生产决策、环境动态和银行部门脆弱性。模型基于2000-2019年波兰宏观经济数据校准，评估了渐进与快速碳税实施及不同减排目标等政策情景。结果显示波兰可在保持宏观经济稳定的同时实现净零排放目标，生产力提升产生积极溢出效应。

title: Building A Thriving Workforce: Psychological Capital As The Key To Employee Wellbeing
affiliations: and Andhra University

detail.title: Building A Thriving Workforce: Psychological Capital As The Key To Employee Wellbeing
detail.abstract: This article examines the significant role that Psychological Capital (PsyCap) factors play in enhancing employee wellbeing within modern organizational contexts. Defined by the positive psychological resources of self-efficacy, hope, optimism, and resilience, PsyCap provides individuals with the internal strength to thrive amidst workplace demands. The paper elucidates how each of these four components directly influences various dimensions of employee wellbeing, including mental health, emotional stability, job satisfaction, and engagement. Specifically, it discusses how self-efficacy boosts confidence and reduces stress, hope fosters goal-directed motivation, optimism cultivates positive coping mechanisms, and resilience enables effective recovery from adversity. Emphasizing the synergistic nature of these factors, the article argues that their combined presence creates a robust psychological foundation for sustained wellbeing. Finally, it underscores the strategic imperative for organizations to recognize and actively develop these psychological capital factors to cultivate a resilient, adaptable, and flourishing workforce.

title: Mapping Outcome-Bias Constructs in AI Recruitment: A Scoping Review of Linguistic and Managerial Perspectives

detail.title: Mapping Outcome-Bias Constructs in AI Recruitment: A Scoping Review of Linguistic and Managerial Perspectives
detail.abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) into recruitment processes promises to enhance efficiency and objectivity, yet it simultaneously introduces complex challenges related to fairness and bias. This scoping review maps the emergent constructs of outcome-bias within AI-powered hiring by establishing an interdisciplinary literature base grounded in linguistic and managerial scholarship. Drawing exclusively on a curated set of foundational papers, this article synthesizes research on how subtle human biases translate into significant discriminatory outcomes, how these biases are encoded and amplified through Natural Language Processing (NLP), and how human-in-the-loop systems are perceived and utilized by recruiters and candidates. We find that outcome-bias in AI recruitment is a socio-technical phenomenon, where linguistic artifacts in training data interact with algorithmic processes and are further mediated by organizational context, recruiter psychology, and applicant perceptions. The review defines key constructs such as outcome-bias, linguistic bias, and augmented hiring to provide a citable conceptual foundation for future research. By systematically identifying critical gaps in the literature-including the lack of focus on intersectional bias, the need for longitudinal studies, the ambiguity of human-AI collaboration, and the limited understanding of organizational integration-this article lays the groundwork for a robust future research agenda, aimed at developing more equitable and effective AI hiring systems.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过范围综述方法，探讨了AI招聘中的结果偏见现象，发现这是一个社会技术现象，涉及训练数据中的语言偏见、算法过程、组织背景和招聘者心理的相互作用。

title: Boosting Banker Performance: The Role Of Psychological Capital
affiliations: and Andhra University

detail.title: Boosting Banker Performance: The Role Of Psychological Capital
detail.abstract: Employee job performance is a crucial determinant of an organization's overall success. In recent years, psychological capital (PsyCap) has garnered increasing attention as a strategic asset to enhance employee effectiveness. Despite global interest in PsyCap, its influence on job performance remains underexplored within the Indian context, particularly in the banking industry. This study aims to examine the relationship between employees' PsyCap and their job performance in the banking sector. A structured questionnaire was administered to a randomly selected sample comprising 376 banking professionals. The survey assessed key components of PsyCap and job performance metrics. Data analysis employed both chi-square and ANOVA techniques to identify significant patterns. Findings revealed a strong positive correlation between psychological capital and job performance, indicating that higher PsyCap levels are associated with improved work outcomes. Based on these results, the study recommends targeted interventions to develop employees' psychological resources such as hope, resilience, optimism, and self-efficacy as a means to boost individual and organizational performance.

detail.abstract: This study critically assesses how Western IR curricula conceptualise international divisions primarily through territorial and economic lenses. While these post-1945 frameworks remain foundational for understanding sovereignty and inequality, they are increasingly insufficient for 21st-century realities. The paper identifies three shortcomings: (1) neglect of technological and algorithmic divisions; (2) limited capacity to account for global health and environmental crises (e.g., COVID-19, climate-induced displacement); and (3) overreliance on the nation-state as the unit of analysis. In response, it advances the “Third Generation in IR (IR3)” which integrates digital infrastructures, data politics, and algorithmic governance. Reframing international divisions through an IR3 lens enables more accurate diagnosis of contemporary power and more relevant curricular reform—linking theory to practice and equipping scholars to address complex, transnational challenges.

title: Grand Strategy: A Review of the World Economic Challenges to Resolve for National Economic Prosperity
affiliations: Heriot-Watt University

detail.title: Grand Strategy: A Review of the World Economic Challenges to Resolve for National Economic Prosperity
detail.abstract: The review identifies and defines world economic challenges to resolve, that will enable national economic prosperity, as well as set out proposed solutions. The review study brings together the fields of strategy and economics to resolve world economic challenges. The research was an exploratory critical review study, with a systematic literature review conducted to spell-out the identified challenges and solutions. The outcomes are an explorative perspective of knowledge gained from identified articles and other publications that provided the most relevant content and study findings on world economic challenges. Content analysis was used to identify the world economic challenges and the respective possible solutions from identified publications. The review established a framework on the five world economic challenges to resolve and proposed solutions to address the identified challenges. The study contributes to knowledge by highlighting (i) the importance for countries to have grand strategies as it relates to the higher-level national strategy and thus promote the development of better business environments and public policies for the betterment of society, (ii) provides a framework on the five world economic challenges to resolve, (iii) proposed solutions to address the identified challenges, and (iv) provision of a theoretical framework that illustrates the development of grand strategies and their implementation process.

title: Transformation of France's Approach to the Concept of Official Development Assistance
affiliations: MGIMO University

detail.title: Transformation of France's Approach to the Concept of Official Development Assistance
detail.abstract: For many years, France has remained one of the key donors of development assistance. In 2024, France provided $15.4 billion of official development assistance (ODA), ranking fifth in the world; this amounted to 0.48% of its gross national income (GNI), placing it 10th-11th globally . However, despite France’s significant position in the global development assistance system, the country’s activities in this area have recently faced criticism, particularly from right-wing political forces . This criticism is notably directed at the work of its main specialized institution, the French Development Agency (fr. AFD — Agence Française de Développement). The increase in negative assessments of AFD’s work in recent months is linked to two main factors: a rise in criticism targeting similar agencies in other developed economies, primarily the United States Agency for International Development (USAID), and the deterioration of France’s public finances, which has led to an urge for austerity and spending cuts. The study examines the specifics of the transformation of France's approach to the ODA concept.

title: A Synthetic Theory of Socio-Epistemic Structuration: Capital, Ideology, and Agency in the Age of Digital Inequality

detail.title: A Synthetic Theory of Socio-Epistemic Structuration: Capital, Ideology, and Agency in the Age of Digital Inequality
detail.abstract: This article proposes a synthetic theory of socio-epistemic structuration to understand the reproduction of inequality in contemporary societies. I argue that social reality is not only determined by material structures and social networks but is fundamentally shaped by the epistemic frameworks-ideologies, narratives, and attributions of agency-that mediate actors' engagement with their environment. The theory integrates findings from critical race theory, network sociology, social capital studies, historical sociology, and analyses of emerging AI agency. I analyze how structures (from the "racial contract" to Facebook networks) and epistemic frameworks (from racist ideology to personal culture) mutually reinforce one another, creating resilient yet unequal life trajectories. Using data from largescale experiments like the Moving to Opportunity and social network analyses, I demonstrate that exposure to diverse environments and social capital is a necessary but insufficient condition for social mobility; epistemic friction, manifested as 'friending bias' and persistent cultural frameworks, systematically limits the benefits of such exposure. I conclude that a public and methodologically reflexive sociology must focus on unpacking and challenging these epistemic structures, recognizing the theoretical capacity of subaltern publics ("reverse tutelage") and developing new methods to disentangle the complex interplay of homophily, contagion, and structural causation in a world of big data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个社会认知结构化综合理论，解释当代社会不平等的再生产机制。该理论强调认知框架（意识形态、叙事、能动性归因）与物质结构共同塑造社会现实，并通过大规模实验数据证明环境多样性和社会资本虽然是社会流动的必要条件，但认知摩擦（如交友偏见、文化框架）系统性地限制了这些条件的效益。

AI.motivation: 理解社会现实不仅由物质结构和社会网络决定，更根本地由认知框架（意识形态、叙事、能动性归因）塑造，这些框架调节着行动者与环境的互动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合批判种族理论、网络社会学、社会资本研究、历史社会学和新兴AI能动性分析，提出社会认知结构化理论。
AI.method: 使用大规模实验数据（如"搬到机会"项目）和社会网络分析，分析环境暴露和社会资本的影响。
AI.findings: 暴露于多样化环境和社会资本是社会流动的必要但不充分条件；认知摩擦（表现为交友偏见和持久文化框架）系统性地限制了这种暴露的效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社会认知结构化理论，强调认知框架与物质结构的相互强化机制；主张公共社会学应聚焦于解构和挑战这些认知结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 认识到从属公众的理论能力（"反向指导"），并开发新方法来理清大数据世界中同质性、传染性和结构性因果关系的复杂互动。

title:
From Coherence to Conscience: A Framework for Quantum-AI Convergence in the Global Energy Transition 
Powering Humanity Beyond Borders

detail.title:
From Coherence to Conscience: A Framework for Quantum-AI Convergence in the Global Energy Transition 
Powering Humanity Beyond Borders
detail.abstract: Quantum technologies and artificial intelligence (AI) are converging with the world's energy systems, creating a generational opportunity to build a quantum-intelligent grid-one that is self-learning, lossfree, and resilient. This paper introduces the concept of a Quantum Energy Web, an infrastructure layer that fuses high-temperature superconductors, quantum-secure communication, and AI-driven optimization to redefine how humanity generates, transmits, and governs power. Drawing on frameworks such as the Gartner Hype Cycle for Disruptive Energy Technologies (2025) and the Energy Industry S-Curve, the analysis situates quantum energy as the fifth great epoch in human technological evolution. Using contemporary data from the International Energy Agency (IEA 2024) and the World Bank (2024), it highlights that nearly 750 million people remain without electricity and over 1.1 billion are energy-poor. The study proposes five strategic impact areas-Grid Intelligence, Quantum Security, Energy Equity, Climate Symbiosis, and Global Governance-as pathways to inclusive progress. Beyond technology, the paper argues that humanity itself remains the decisive variable. It concludes with a call for a new ethic of accountability, positioning every citizen as a participant in shaping the planetary algorithms that will govern the Quantum Shift.

title: Adhocracy Culture: Innovation at the Edge

detail.title: Adhocracy Culture: Innovation at the Edge

declarations.declarationOfInterest: n/a
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: n/a

detail.abstract: This article examines adhocracy culture, an organizational archetype defined by innovation, agility, and risk-taking. Drawing on Toffler's and Mintzberg's foundational work and frameworks such as the OCAI and Denison Model, it outlines how adhocracy contrasts with stability-oriented cultures and flourishes through decentralized decisionmaking, informal communication, and tolerance for failure. Case studies from Google, IDEO, and SpaceX illustrate how adhocracy enables breakthrough innovation but also highlight risks of incoherence, burnout, and governance gaps. Practical strategies for strengthening adhocracy include cultivating safe-to-fail environments, embedding innovation pipelines, aligning policies and incentives, and leveraging storytelling and symbols to normalize experimentation. The article also explores contemporary influences: digital platforms and AI as accelerators of experimentation, remote work as a challenge for maintaining creative rituals, and regulation as a driver of ethical guardrails. Ultimately, adhocracy culture represents freedom with purpose, requiring leaders to balance speed with sustainability and model curiosity, humility, and resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了临时组织文化（adhocracy culture）这一以创新、敏捷和风险承担为特征的组织原型。基于Toffler和Mintzberg的理论框架，分析了临时组织文化与稳定性导向文化的对比，并通过Google、IDEO和SpaceX的案例研究展示了其促进突破性创新的能力及潜在风险。文章提出了加强临时组织文化的实践策略，并探讨了数字技术、远程工作和监管等当代影响因素。
AI.research_question: 临时组织文化如何促进组织创新，以及如何平衡其带来的创新优势与潜在风险？
AI.motivation: 在快速变化的商业环境中，组织需要创新和敏捷性来保持竞争力。临时组织文化作为一种强调创新、风险承担和灵活性的组织模式，对现代组织具有重要意义，但其实现和维持面临挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Toffler和Mintzberg的组织理论，运用OCAI（组织文化评估工具）和Denison模型等框架来分析临时组织文化的特征和运作机制。
AI.method: 采用理论框架分析和案例研究方法，通过Google、IDEO和SpaceX等企业的案例来验证理论观点。
AI.findings: 临时组织文化通过分权决策、非正式沟通和对失败的容忍促进突破性创新，但也可能导致组织不连贯、员工倦怠和治理缺口等问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对临时组织文化特征和运作机制的理解，提出了在当代环境下加强临时组织文化的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了培育安全失败环境、嵌入创新流程、调整政策激励、利用故事和符号等实践策略，帮助组织有效实施临时组织文化。

title: GCN-LSTM Approach for Predicting Printer Sales: Pre- vs. Post-COVID-19 Analysis
affiliations: Yuan Ze University, Yuan Ze University, Yuan Ze University and Yuan Ze University

detail.title: GCN-LSTM Approach for Predicting Printer Sales: Pre- vs. Post-COVID-19 Analysis
detail.abstract: Sales prediction is essential for optimizing inventory, resources, and production in the competitive printer industry, where product interdependencies heavily affect overall sales. The COVID-19 pandemic reshaped the market, with increased demand for multifunction printers (MFC) driven by the work-from-home concept and supply chain disruptions, challenging traditional predictions. A hybrid GCN-LSTM model was applied to historical printer sales data, comparing performance across pre- and post-COVID-19 periods. GCN analyzed inter-brand sales features, while LSTM captured spatial-temporal relationships. Experimental data obtained from IDC report with Hong Kong and Thailand quarterly sales data over 10 years will be used, and other comparison algorithms such as ST-GCN and LSTM alone, especially in inter-brand dynamics. The hybrid model excelled in Hong Kong, where high population density and work-from-home boosted MFC demand post-COVID-19, enhancing prediction accuracy. In Thailand, with its urban-rural divide and lower COVID-19 impact, MFC demand remained steady, yielding minimal accuracy differences across periods. This research underscores the hybrid model's robustness in predicting printer sales amid varied market conditions, providing insights for strategy adaptation in evolving markets.

AI.tldr: 本研究应用混合GCN-LSTM模型预测打印机销售，分析COVID-19前后市场变化。模型在香港表现优异，因高人口密度和居家办公推动MFC需求；在泰国因城乡差异和疫情影响较小，准确率差异不大。
AI.research_question: 混合GCN-LSTM模型如何在COVID-19疫情前后有效预测打印机销售，特别是在不同市场条件下？
AI.motivation: 打印机行业竞争激烈，产品相互依存影响整体销售。COVID-19疫情重塑市场，居家办公推动多功能打印机需求增长，供应链中断挑战传统预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图卷积网络(GCN)分析品牌间销售特征，长短期记忆网络(LSTM)捕捉时空关系，结合形成混合模型。
AI.method: 使用IDC报告的香港和泰国10年季度销售数据，比较混合GCN-LSTM模型与ST-GCN和单独LSTM的性能，特别关注品牌间动态。
AI.findings: 混合模型在香港表现优异，因高人口密度和居家办公推动MFC需求；在泰国因城乡差异和疫情影响较小，准确率差异不大。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了混合GCN-LSTM模型在预测打印机销售中的稳健性，特别是在市场条件变化时。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在不断变化的市场中调整策略提供见解，优化库存、资源和生产计划。

title: Economic Displacement and Social Welfare: Money, Macroeconomy, and the Hollowing of the U.S. Middle Class, 1971–2025
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Economic Displacement and Social Welfare: Money, Macroeconomy, and the Hollowing of the U.S. Middle Class, 1971–2025

declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics
declarations.funderStatement: No funders

detail.abstract: After Watergate, Congress briefly tightened campaign finance through the Federal Election Campaign Act (1974). Within a few years, court decisions (Buckley v. Valeo, 1976) and the emergence of new vehicles, including PACs (later super PACs and nondisclosing nonprofits), reopened pathways for large-scale private influence. A second structural break arrived with the 1971 Nixon shock, which ended dollar-gold convertibility and, alongside the 1973-74 oil shocks, entrenched a dollar-centric energy system and accelerated financialization. From the late 1970s onward, three trends moved in tandem: (1) outside money in elections surged-especially after Citizens United and Speech Now (2010); (2) the U.S. middle class shrank while the productivity-pay link loosened and union density fell; and (3) party gatekeeping eroded as primaries and outside cash empowered polarized, donor-dependent candidacies. Social welfare policy shifted from entitlement expansion to work-conditioned, time-limited support (PRWORA, 1996), even as deindustrialization and trade exposure (the "China Shock") generated persistent regional scarring. This paper synthesizes legal, macroeconomic, and distributional evidence, maps it to a 1971-2025 timeline, and proposes a policy mix that couple's campaign-finance transparency and small-donor power with labor institutions, targeted industrial policy, and modernized social protection. The practical implication is straightforward: without rebuilding middle-class bargaining power and electoral guardrails, governance quality will continue to skew towards fundraising prowess and performative polarization rather than problem-solving competence.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了1971年以来美国政治经济结构的转变，包括竞选资金改革失败、金融化加速、中产阶级萎缩等趋势，并提出重建中产阶级议价能力和选举护栏的政策方案。
AI.research_question: 1971年以来美国政治经济结构如何演变，以及如何通过政策组合重建中产阶级议价能力和选举护栏？
AI.motivation: 水门事件后竞选资金改革失败，加上尼克松冲击和石油危机加速金融化，导致选举中外部资金激增、中产阶级萎缩、政党把关功能削弱等结构性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合法律、宏观经济和分配理论，分析竞选资金、金融化、劳动力市场和社会福利政策的相互作用。
AI.method: 综合法律、宏观经济和分配证据，映射到1971-2025年时间线，进行历史制度分析。
AI.findings: 三个趋势同步发展：选举外部资金激增、中产阶级萎缩和政党把关功能削弱，导致治理质量偏向筹款能力和表演性极化而非问题解决能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了连接竞选资金、金融化、劳动力市场和社会福利政策的综合分析框架，揭示政治经济结构的系统性转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出政策组合：竞选资金透明化和小额捐款赋权，结合劳工制度、针对性产业政策和现代化社会保障，重建中产阶级议价能力和选举护栏。

title: The Ironically Important Role of Incidental Take Authorizations in Whale Conservation
affiliations: University of Miami, University of Miami - School of Law and University of Miami

detail.title: The Ironically Important Role of Incidental Take Authorizations in Whale Conservation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Stanford Environmental Law Journal, Volume 44, pp 167-222

detail.abstract: The late 1970s and early ‘80s saw a regime shift in wildlife protection under the Marine Mammal Protection Act (MMPA) and the Endangered Species Act (ESA). That shift may be impeding the recovery of cetaceans (whales, dolphins, and porpoise species) in ways that are yet underexplored. As enacted, the MMPA and ESA established a conservation framework designed to reduce, to the fullest extent possible, “takes” of protected species. Between 1978 and 1982, a series of amendments to both statutes introduced a complex web of incidental take authorizations designed to ensure Congress’ initial push for wildlife conservation would not impede economic growth and development. Today, mitigation requirements implemented within incidental take authorizations form the basis for most federal regulatory efforts to alleviate threats to cetaceans. Despite their weighty role in cetacean conservation, few studies examine the National Marine Fisheries Service’s (NMFS) authorization of incidental takes of cetaceans. This Article—focusing on whales—examines NMFS’ implementation of three types of incidental take authorizations: ESA Section 7 Incidental Take Statements, MMPA Section 101(a)(5)(A) Letters of Authorization, and MMPA 101(a)(5)(D) Incidental Harassment Authorizations. We identify three drawbacks to the incidental take authorization system. First, Congress never intended take authorizations to serve as the primary tool to mitigate harms to species, yet they seem to be playing that role. The incidental take frameworks are structurally inadequate to mitigate anthropogenic harms to cetaceans to the extent necessary to facilitate species recovery. Second, increasing numbers and sizes of incidental take authorizations paired with an inadequate consideration of cumulative impacts during the authorization process may contribute to an excess of authorized takes. Third, incidental take authorizations fail to protect previously occupied and data-deficient habitats whose protection may be necessary for species recovery. Though we focus on whales, the lessons learned from this analysis have implications for a wide variety of taxa. This Article calls for a drastic reformulation of policy approaches to recovery and conservation under the MMPA and ESA. First, we suggest ideas to bring NMFS implementation of the Acts back in-line with the precautionary approach intended by Congress when the statutes were first passed. Second, we suggest a greater utilization of offsets as a means to protect data-deficient or unoccupied habitat. Finally, we stress that more proactive measures be taken outside of the confines of the ITA frameworks to protect cetaceans.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国《海洋哺乳动物保护法》和《濒危物种法》中的附带捕捞授权制度对鲸类保护的负面影响，指出该制度存在结构性缺陷、累积影响考虑不足、栖息地保护缺失等问题，并提出政策改革建议。
AI.research_question: 美国国家海洋渔业局实施的附带捕捞授权制度如何影响鲸类物种的恢复和保护？
AI.motivation: 1970年代末至80年代初，MMPA和ESA的修订引入了复杂的附带捕捞授权框架，这些授权现在构成了联邦保护鲸类的主要监管工具，但其效果和影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境法规实施理论、附带捕捞授权制度分析框架、累积环境影响评估理论
AI.method: 分析NMFS实施的三种附带捕捞授权类型：ESA第7条附带捕捞声明、MMPA第101(a)(5)(A)条授权书、MMPA第101(a)(5)(D)条骚扰授权
AI.findings: 1)附带捕捞授权制度结构上不足以减轻人为伤害；2)授权数量和规模增加但累积影响考虑不足；3)未能保护历史栖息地和数据缺乏栖息地
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了附带捕捞授权制度在物种保护中的结构性缺陷，提出了环境法规实施与物种恢复目标之间的张力理论
AI.practical_contributions: 建议：1)回归国会预期的预防性原则；2)利用补偿机制保护数据缺乏栖息地；3)在授权框架外采取更积极的保护措施

title: Enhancing Organisational Citizenship Behaviour and Strategic HRD for Organisational Effectiveness in Developing Countries
affiliations: Nepal Open University

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest of the author in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper has used no primary data and used no participants, obtaining ethics approval statement is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no funding or financial assistance.

detail.abstract: Organisational Citizenship Behaviour (OCB) and Strategic Human Resource Development (SHRD) have been increasingly recognised in management scholarship as mutually reinforcing constructs that significantly contribute to organisational effectiveness (OE). OCB, encompassing discretionary and extra-role behaviours beyond formal job prescriptions, reflects employees’ intrinsic motivation and social exchange mechanisms that underpin organisational functioning. Strategic HRD, on the other hand, constitutes a systemic and future-oriented approach to developing human capital, aligning learning and development interventions with long-term organisational goals. Theoretically, OCB aligns with social exchange theory and organisational support theory, while Strategic HRD is grounded in the resource-based view (RBV) and human capital theory, collectively offering a multidimensional framework for achieving OE. This paper synthesises extant literature to contextualise the OCB–HRD nexus in developing countries, where institutional voids, resource constraints, and evolving organisational landscapes necessitate innovative approaches to workforce development. The analysis underscores that cultivating OCB through strategically designed HRD mechanisms enhances organisational adaptability, resilience, and sustainable performance, thereby reinforcing the centrality of human agency in driving effectiveness in resource-constrained contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了组织公民行为(OCB)与战略性人力资源开发(SHRD)在发展中国家的协同关系，强调通过战略性HRD机制培养OCB能够提升组织适应性、韧性和可持续绩效。
AI.research_question: 在发展中国家的制度空白和资源约束背景下，组织公民行为(OCB)与战略性人力资源开发(SHRD)如何相互促进并共同提升组织效能？
AI.motivation: 管理学界日益认识到OCB和SHRD作为相互强化的构念对组织效能的重要贡献，特别是在发展中国家面临制度空白、资源约束和不断演变的组织环境时，需要创新的劳动力发展方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: OCB基于社会交换理论和组织支持理论，SHRD基于资源基础观(RBV)和人力资本理论，共同构成了实现组织效能的多维理论框架。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合现有文献来情境化发展中国家的OCB-HRD关系。
AI.findings: 通过战略性设计的HRD机制培养OCB能够增强组织适应性、韧性和可持续绩效，在资源约束环境中强化了人力能动性在推动效能中的核心地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了社会交换理论、组织支持理论、资源基础观和人力资本理论，为理解OCB与SHRD的协同关系提供了多维理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家的组织提供了通过战略性HRD实践培养OCB的具体路径，以应对资源约束和制度挑战，提升组织效能。

title: Network States, Networked Sovereignities, and Algorithmic Nations: Anticipatory AI-Driven Policy and Emerging Sovereignties Amid the Confederal Basque Country
affiliations: Ikerbasque Foundation UPV/EHU

detail.title: Network States, Networked Sovereignities, and Algorithmic Nations: Anticipatory AI-Driven Policy and Emerging Sovereignties Amid the Confederal Basque Country

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Basque Foundation for Science

detail.abstract:
The Basque Country is currently experiencing a rapid transformation into a leading European hub for Artificial Intelligence, Web3 technologies, and digital public infrastructure. With over 771 AI actors in the region and a €189m investment in quantum‑AI firms like Multiverse Computing, it stands at the forefront of innovation in Europe. Anchor initiatives—including the public rollout of a LoRaWAN IoT network expected to connect 300,000+ sensors by 2028 and the vaka-based “Industria Digitala 2025” funding program—reflect ambitious regional efforts to assert digital sovereignty through infrastructure and industrial renewal.

Against this backdrop, this paper interrogates emerging forms of territorialized sovereignty enabled by Web3 decentralization and Generative AI—phenomena this paper terms Algorithmic Nations. Drawing from the AI4SI Observatory in Gipuzkoa—a participatory governance platform that combines blockchain, DAOs, and data cooperatives to democratize AI impact evaluation—I examine how these technologies are being mobilized to recalibrate relationships among regions, states, and digital public spheres.

This paper situates these developments in the context of anticipatory governance, expanding on recent analyses of the Basque model (Beel et al., 2025) which identify a critical juncture between institutional continuity and emerging imaginaries of post-neoliberal development. Building on fieldwork from the AI4SI Observatory in Gipuzkoa—a participatory platform combining blockchain, DAOs, and data cooperatives—I introduce three conceptual frameworks: Network States, Networked Sovereignties, and Algorithmic Nations. These paradigms help theorize how territorialized digital infrastructures are reshaping relationships between regions, states, and digital public spheres. Building on theoretical and ethnographic work across Silicon Valley, the Basque Country, and Iceland—and engaging with Protocol Labs’ “Generalized Impact Evaluators” and the Deep Funding Challenge—this paper explores and compares three paradigms already published in the journals Regional Studies Regional Science, Future Internet and Data & Policy: Network States, Network Sovereignties, and Algorithmic Nations. In the Basque context, these paradigms converge within practices aimed at blending industrial reindustrialization, territorial data justice, and democratic participation. However, I also critique how tokenized evaluators risk reproducing technocratic hierarchies unless grounded in territorial reflexivity and plural valuation.

The Basque case reveals both the democratic potential and technocratic pitfalls of algorithmically mediated governance. As a testbed for hybrid and anticipatory regional futures, it exemplifies how plural, place-based approaches to AI, data, and digital infrastructure can reimagine sovereignty and nationhood in the algorithmic age. The paper offers a critical framework that situates the Basque digital transition as a political experiment: a testbed for decentralized infrastructures that are industrially effective, democratically accountable, and culturally embedded. Ultimately, it argues that only by integrating local epistemologies, digital public infrastructure, and plural impact evaluation can emerging sovereignties transcend mere rhetoric and genuinely reimagine nationhood in the algorithmic age.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了巴斯克地区如何通过Web3去中心化和生成式AI技术构建"算法国家"，分析了这些技术如何重塑地区、国家和数字公共领域之间的关系，并批判性地评估了算法治理的民主潜力和技术官僚风险。
AI.research_question: Web3去中心化和生成式AI技术如何促成新的领土化主权形式（算法国家），以及这些技术如何重新校准地区、国家和数字公共领域之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 巴斯克地区正在快速转型为欧洲人工智能、Web3技术和数字公共基础设施的领先中心，这一发展为研究新兴的领土化数字主权形式提供了独特案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络国家、网络主权和算法国家三个概念框架，结合预期治理理论和后新自由主义发展想象。
AI.method: 基于AI4SI观察站的实地调查，结合硅谷、巴斯克地区和冰岛的理论和人种志研究，分析Protocol Labs的"广义影响评估器"和深度资助挑战。
AI.findings: 巴斯克案例揭示了算法中介治理的民主潜力和技术官僚陷阱，表明只有整合地方认识论、数字公共基础设施和多元影响评估，新兴主权才能超越修辞，真正重新构想算法时代的国家形态。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了算法国家的概念框架，扩展了关于数字主权和领土化治理的理论理解，为分析区域数字转型提供了批判性视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何平衡工业有效性、民主问责和文化嵌入性的实践指导，强调了地方认识论和多元评估在数字治理中的重要性。

detail.abstract: The text discusses the powerful impact a film can have on the human mind. When a creator authentically conveys a genuine perspective – even one of hardship or struggle – without ulterior motives, it can resonate deeply with audiences. This honest portrayal can serve as a guiding light, helping people navigate their own lives and inspiring positive change, ultimately contributing to a better world.

AI.tldr: 电影通过真诚表达创作者的真实视角（包括困境和挣扎），能够深刻影响观众心灵，成为人生指引，激发积极改变，促进世界更好发展。

detail.abstract: This Essay, written for the “Who Governs Debt’s Dominion” symposium, looks back on Debt’s Dominion: A History of Bankruptcy Law in America as the twenty-fifth anniversary of the book’s publication nears. The Essay begins, in Part I, by briefly describing how Debt’s Dominion came about. Part II identifies and seeks to explain a striking decline in optimism about American bankruptcy law since Debt’s Dominion was first published. Part III explores a few of the major recent developments in consumer bankruptcy, small business bankruptcy, and large-scale corporate reorganization that I would have analyzed in the book if it were written today. Part IV briefly considers the impact of globalization and concludes the new epilogue.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了《债务的统治：美国破产法史》出版25周年，分析了美国破产法乐观态度的下降，探讨了消费者破产、小企业破产和大规模企业重组的最新发展，并考虑了全球化的影响。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史分析和法律演变理论，探讨破产法的制度变迁。
AI.method: 文献回顾和历史分析方法，结合当前破产法实践的观察。
AI.findings: 发现对美国破产法的乐观态度显著下降，消费者破产、小企业破产和大规模企业重组领域出现了重要新发展，全球化对破产法产生了深远影响。

title: Nurses’ Perceptions Towards Continuous Nursing Education (CNE) Program in Oman: A Cross-sectional Descriptive Study
affiliations: Sultan Qaboos University, ,  and

detail.title: Nurses’ Perceptions Towards Continuous Nursing Education (CNE) Program in Oman: A Cross-sectional Descriptive Study
detail.abstract:
Background: Provision of a high-quality continuous nursing education (CNE) is deemed to be an integral aspect of continuing professional development, therefore measuring the nurses' views and beliefs toward the conducted CNE is highly required. The aims of this study are to explore nurses' attitudes and perceptions of taking a part in CNE program and the perceived facilitators and barriers toward attending CNE program. 

Methods: This quantitative study used a survey questionnaire that was sent to all nurses attending CNE at SQUH (around 1350 nurses) in June 2023 for 6 months, asking about their attitudes and perceptions toward conducted educational sessions and the perceived facilitators and barriers to attend CNE. 

Results: The respondent rate to the questionnaire was 594 nurses. Demographical data showed a high association between high CNE participation and both "high qualification and level of experience". Findings suggested that updating nurses' knowledge and developing their nursing career are the most common beliefs in regards to the nurses' attitudes towards CNE, with respective means of 1.39 and 1.48.  Additionally, all mean scores for nurses' perception were very high and in general; CNE viewed it as a valuable component of nursing practice. Gaining of new skills and quality of conducted CNE were the most viewed motivating factors to participate in CNE, while nurses' workload and shift duty was considered as a barrier for attending more CNE sessions. 

Conclusions Conducting CNE is considered an important measure to improve nurses' personal growth and job satisfaction. Positive attitudes and perceptions should be boosted in order to encourage nurses in improving their nursing practice and providing quality patient care. Findings from this study are useful in reevaluating the conducted CNE in order to find the best motivational factors and minimize the effects of hindering factors.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过问卷调查探讨护士对继续护理教育(CNE)的态度、认知以及参与CNE的促进因素和障碍因素。研究发现护士普遍认为CNE对更新知识和职业发展很重要，工作负荷和轮班是主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 护士对参与继续护理教育(CNE)项目的态度和认知是什么？参与CNE的促进因素和障碍因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 提供高质量的继续护理教育是专业发展的重要组成部分，需要了解护士对CNE的看法和信念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于继续专业发展理论和成人学习理论，关注护士对教育活动的态度、认知和行为影响因素。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，使用问卷调查，向SQUH医院的1350名护士发放问卷，收集他们对CNE的态度、认知以及促进和障碍因素的数据。
AI.findings: 1. 高学历和高经验水平与高CNE参与度相关；2. 更新知识和职业发展是护士对CNE的主要态度；3. 护士普遍认为CNE是护理实践的重要组成部分；4. 获得新技能和CNE质量是主要促进因素；5. 工作负荷和轮班是主要障碍因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了继续护理教育领域的实证研究，为理解护士参与继续教育的态度和行为提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医疗机构优化CNE项目提供实践指导，帮助识别促进因素和消除障碍因素，提高护士参与度和教育效果。

detail.abstract: A Customer-Focused Culture represents an organizational philosophy in which the customer becomes the central reference point for all decisions, processes and behaviors. It integrates the principles of empathy, responsiveness and reliability to ensure that customer needs and experiences define how success is measured and achieved. Drawing from foundational theories such as SERVQUAL, Total Quality Management, and design thinking, the article traces the evolution of customer centricity from a service-quality construct into a holistic cultural framework embedded across all business functions. It examines the defining traits, leadership models and operational practices that sustain this culture while analyzing the risks of burnout, scope creep and scaling challenges. The article concludes that customer focus must balance empathy with operational discipline to remain sustainable, highlighting that true customer centricity is not an endpoint but a continuous discipline of learning, adapting, and serving with integrity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了以客户为中心的文化如何从服务质量概念发展为全面的组织文化框架，强调需要在同理心与运营纪律之间取得平衡，并指出真正的客户中心性是一个持续学习、适应和诚信服务的连续过程。

title: Relationships and Loneliness in Evolving Work Contexts: The Social Implications of Virtual Jobs and Gig Arrangements
affiliations: , University of Massachusetts Lowell, University of Massachusetts Lowell and University of Massachusetts Lowell

detail.title: Relationships and Loneliness in Evolving Work Contexts: The Social Implications of Virtual Jobs and Gig Arrangements

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming in: E. Hughes, J. Krueger, T. Roberts, and A. Seeman (Eds.), An Interdisciplinary Investigation of Loneliness. London: Bloomsbury.

detail.abstract: In this chapter, we explore how major changes to employment are altering relational dynamics and thus people’s experiences of loneliness in work contexts. We focus on virtual (i.e., hybrid or remote) jobs and gig (i.e., external, contract-based) arrangements, which are increasingly prevalent globally. Drawing on research from multiple literatures (e.g., organizational, social psychology, human-computer interaction), we identify key attributes of virtual jobs and gig arrangements that influence work relationships. First, we suggest that relationships evolve differently in virtual jobs due to limited physical proximity, greater reliance on digital communication technologies, and reduced commuting. Second, we propose that gig arrangements shape relationships through low organizational integration, time-bounded affiliation, and outsider status. These key attributes of virtual jobs and gig arrangements have complex social implications: although they often act as relationship inhibitors—thwarting the development and deepening of interpersonal connections—they can also serve as relationship facilitators—enabling greater relational choice, creativity, and access. Building on our discussion of these mixed effects, we outline fruitful avenues for future research and offer practical recommendations for organizations.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨虚拟工作和零工经济如何通过改变工作关系动态影响职场孤独感，分析了虚拟工作的物理距离限制、数字技术依赖和通勤减少，以及零工经济的低组织整合、时间限制和外部身份等特征对人际关系的双重影响。
AI.research_question: 虚拟工作和零工经济安排如何改变工作关系动态并影响人们的职场孤独感？
AI.motivation: 随着虚拟工作和零工经济的全球普及，这些新型就业形式正在重塑工作关系，需要系统研究其对人际关系和孤独感的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合组织行为学、社会心理学和人机交互等多个领域的理论，分析工作关系形成机制。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，综合多个学科领域的研究成果进行理论分析。
AI.findings: 虚拟工作和零工经济对工作关系具有双重影响：既是关系抑制因素（阻碍人际连接发展），也是关系促进因素（提供更多关系选择、创造性和接触机会）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了虚拟工作和零工经济影响工作关系的理论框架，识别了关键属性及其社会影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了管理虚拟工作和零工关系的实践建议，帮助优化工作关系质量。

title: Knowledge without Borders: Cross-region Innovation Spillover within Business Groups
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU), Southwest University of Finance and Economics, Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University,  and Hong Kong Polytechnic University

detail.title: Knowledge without Borders: Cross-region Innovation Spillover within Business Groups
detail.abstract: Although place-based innovation policies typically focus on specific regions, policy effects can spill over through particular networks. However, the evidence of such innovation spillover remains sparse. Utilizing the staggered establishment of national high-tech zones (HTZs) in China as a quasi-natural experiment, we investigate innovation spillover across regions through business groups. We find that the establishment of HTZs spurs corporate innovation not only in subsidiaries in targeted regions but also in subsidiaries in non-targeted regions. Specifically, for subsidiaries in non-HTZ regions, there is an average increase in innovation of 8.2%. Our results suggest that the spillover effect is not influenced by geographic distance, but is driven 1) by the internal knowledge market, which facilitates knowledge sharing through collaborations with inventors who have filed patents in HTZs, and 2) by citing patents held by targeted subsidiaries within the same business groups in HTZs. Besides, remaining inventors in subsidiaries become more productive due to inter-firm knowledge spillovers. The effect is stronger when the firms in targeted regions possess higher relative power within business groups and maintain internal managerial linkages with treated subsidiaries. Overall, this study sheds light on the significance of knowledge sharing and collaboration within business groups in driving innovation and fostering positive externalities beyond geographic boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本文利用中国国家级高新区的设立作为准自然实验，研究发现高新区政策不仅促进了目标区域的子公司创新，还通过企业集团网络产生了跨区域创新溢出效应，非目标区域子公司的创新平均提升8.2%。这种溢出效应不受地理距离影响，而是通过内部知识市场（与在高新区申请专利的发明人合作）和引用同一企业集团内高新区子公司的专利来实现。
AI.research_question: 国家级高新区的设立是否通过企业集团网络产生跨区域创新溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 虽然基于地点的创新政策通常关注特定区域，但政策效应可能通过特定网络产生溢出，但关于此类创新溢出的证据仍然稀少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业集团网络、知识溢出理论、内部知识市场理论
AI.method: 利用中国国家级高新区的交错设立作为准自然实验，采用实证分析方法
AI.findings: 1. 高新区设立不仅促进目标区域子公司创新，还使非目标区域子公司创新平均提升8.2%；2. 溢出效应不受地理距离影响；3. 溢出机制包括：与在高新区申请专利的发明人合作、引用同一企业集团内高新区子公司的专利；4. 剩余发明人因企业间知识溢出而更有效率
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业集团内部知识共享和协作在推动创新和超越地理边界产生正外部性方面的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于创新政策溢出效应的新视角，强调了企业集团网络在知识传播中的重要作用

title: The Money Laundering Reporting Officer: Some Reflections from Malta
affiliations: University of Malta - Department of Banking and Finance and Malta Financial Services Authority

detail.title: The Money Laundering Reporting Officer: Some Reflections from Malta
detail.abstract: The role of the Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) has become increasingly complex and critical in the face of evolving regulatory frameworks and rapid technological advancements. This paper examines the expanding responsibilities of MLROs, particularly within the context of the European Union's new AML supervisory framework and the proliferation of financial technology. It explores the multifaceted challenges faced by MLROs, including the need for technical expertise, regulatory compliance, and proactive risk management in an era of heightened personal liability. The paper also highlights the transformative potential of artificial intelligence (AI) and data-driven solutions in enhancing AML/CFT processes, while emphasising the irreplaceable role of human judgment in addressing emerging risks. Furthermore, it underscores the ethical and legal considerations associated with the adoption of advanced technologies, particularly in relation to data privacy and civil liberties. Ultimately, this paper argues that the successful navigation of these dynamic challenges by AML/CFT professionals is essential to maintaining the integrity and resilience of the global financial system in an increasingly complex and high-stakes environment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了反洗钱报告官(MLRO)在欧盟新监管框架和金融科技发展下面临的职责扩展、技术挑战、个人责任风险，以及AI技术在反洗钱工作中的潜力和局限性。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟新反洗钱监管框架和金融科技快速发展的背景下，反洗钱报告官(MLRO)面临哪些新的职责挑战和技术需求？
AI.motivation: 随着监管框架的演变和技术进步，反洗钱报告官的角色变得越来越复杂和关键，需要应对技术专长、合规要求和风险管理等多重挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于反洗钱/打击资助恐怖主义(AML/CFT)监管理论、风险管理理论和金融科技应用理论。
AI.method: 理论分析和案例研究，结合欧盟新监管框架和金融科技发展的实证分析。
AI.findings: MLRO职责显著扩展，需要技术专长和主动风险管理能力；AI和数据驱动解决方案能增强反洗钱流程，但人类判断仍不可替代；技术应用需平衡数据隐私和公民自由等伦理法律考量。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对MLRO角色演变的理论理解，提出了在技术变革时代反洗钱专业人员的综合能力框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构和监管机构提供了应对新监管环境和技术挑战的实践指导，强调了技术应用与人类判断的平衡策略。

detail.abstract: This case study examines hierarchy culture as defined within the Competing Values Framework, emphasizing the values of stability, order, and control as the foundation of organizational effectiveness. Through the story of Atlas Industries-a Japanese-founded global manufacturing company-it illustrates how hierarchy enables consistency, reliability, and accountability in complex, high-risk environments. The narrative traces the evolution from founder Kenji Tanaka's rigid, rule-based leadership to successor Naomi Hayes's adaptive transformation program, "Project Equilibrium," which sought to preserve hierarchy's virtues while infusing flexibility and trust. The study explores hierarchy's historical roots in classical management theory, its strengths in ensuring procedural discipline and its vulnerabilities in the face of rapid technological and market change. Ultimately, it argues that hierarchy's enduring relevance lies not in resisting change but in managing it responsibly: sustaining discipline as a platform for learning and adaptability in the digital age. The transformation of Atlas illustrates that order and agility are not opposing forces but complementary imperatives for organizational resilience.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过Atlas Industries案例探讨层级文化在竞争价值观框架中的作用，分析其如何在保持稳定性和秩序的同时适应变革，最终实现秩序与灵活性的平衡。
AI.research_question: 层级文化如何在复杂高风险环境中保持组织有效性，同时适应快速变化的技术和市场环境？
AI.motivation: 探讨层级文化在数字时代是否仍然具有相关性，以及如何平衡传统层级结构的稳定性与现代组织所需的灵活性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争价值观框架中的层级文化理论，强调稳定性、秩序和控制作为组织有效性的基础。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以Atlas Industries这家日本创立的全球制造公司为研究对象。
AI.findings: 层级文化通过确保程序纪律和可靠性在复杂环境中发挥重要作用；通过"Project Equilibrium"转型项目，Atlas成功在保持层级优势的同时注入灵活性和信任；秩序与敏捷性可以成为互补而非对立的力量。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对层级文化在现代组织中作用的理解，提出了层级文化可以通过适应性转型保持相关性的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织如何在保持传统层级优势的同时实现数字化转型提供了实践指导，展示了秩序与灵活性可以协同促进组织韧性。

title: Economic Displacement and Social Welfare: Money, Macroeconomy, and the Hollowing of the U.S. Middle Class, 1971–2025

declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics

detail.abstract: After Watergate, Congress briefly tightened campaign finance through the Federal Election Campaign Act (1974). Within a few years, court decisions (Buckley v. Valeo, 1976) and the emergence of new vehicles, including PACs (later super PACs and nondisclosing nonprofits), reopened pathways for large-scale private influence. A second structural break arrived with the 1971 Nixon shock, which ended dollar-gold convertibility and, alongside the 1973-74 oil shocks, entrenched a dollar-centric energy system and accelerated financialization. From the late 1970s onward, three trends moved in tandem: (1) outside money in elections surged, especially after Citizens United and Speech Now (2010); (2) the U.S. middle class shrank while the productivity-pay link loosened and union density fell; and (3) party gatekeeping eroded as primaries and outside cash empowered polarized, donor-dependent candidacies. Social welfare policy shifted from entitlement expansion to work-conditioned, time-limited support (PRWORA, 1996), even as deindustrialization and trade exposure (the "China Shock") generated persistent regional scarring. This paper synthesizes legal, macroeconomic, and distributional evidence, maps it to a timeline from 1971 to 2025, and proposes a policy mix that couples campaign-finance transparency and small-donor power with labor institutions, targeted industrial policy, and modernized social protection. The practical implication is straightforward: without rebuilding middle-class bargaining power and electoral guardrails, governance quality will continue to skew towards fundraising prowess and performative polarization rather than problem-solving competence.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了1970年代以来美国政治经济结构的三大变化：选举资金改革失效导致大额私人资金影响政治；美元体系变革加速金融化；中产阶级萎缩与政党门控机制崩溃。论文提出需要重建中产阶级议价能力和选举护栏的政策组合。
AI.research_question: 1970年代以来美国政治经济结构如何演变，以及如何通过政策组合重建中产阶级议价能力和选举护栏？
AI.motivation: 水门事件后选举资金改革失败，加上尼克松冲击和石油危机引发的结构性变化，导致美国政治经济体系向大额私人资金倾斜，中产阶级萎缩，治理质量下降。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合法律、宏观经济和分配理论，分析选举资金、金融化、阶级结构变化之间的相互关系。
AI.method: 综合法律、宏观经济和分配证据，绘制1971-2025年时间线，提出政策组合方案。
AI.findings: 三大趋势同步发展：选举外部资金激增、中产阶级萎缩、政党门控机制崩溃，导致社会政策从权利扩张转向工作条件限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了选举资金、金融化和阶级结构变化的综合分析框架，揭示了政治经济结构的相互关联性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出包含选举资金透明度、小额捐赠者权力、劳工制度、针对性产业政策和现代化社会保护的政策组合方案。

title: A3 as the Integrative Completion of Systems Science and Cybernetics
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A3 as the Integrative Completion of Systems Science and Cybernetics
detail.abstract: This paper demonstrates that the A3 Model (Aram-Aanavam-Adhikaram) fully satisfies and extends the foundational scientific components of Systems Science and Cybernetics. Through explicit, component-by-component mapping, the A3 framework is shown to meet every classical structural, functional, and reflexive requirement while introducing recursive ethical coherence as a higher-order governing principle. By internalizing ethics (Aram), distortion awareness (Aanavam), and agency fitness (Adhikaram) as continuous feedback mechanisms, A3 transforms traditional systemic regulation into recursive moral governance. The model reinterprets feedback, purpose, and viability as ethical primitives, aligning self-regulation with legitimacy and coherence across human, institutional, and artificial systems. This synthesis positions A3 as a comprehensive and complete systems architecture, representing a new order in cybernetics and systemic science capable of governing complexity with moral and epistemic integrity.

AI.tldr: A3模型（Aram-Aanavam-Adhikaram）完全满足并扩展了系统科学和控制论的基础科学组件，通过将伦理、失真意识和代理适应性作为连续反馈机制，将传统系统调节转变为递归道德治理。
AI.research_question: A3模型如何满足并扩展系统科学和控制论的基础科学组件？
AI.motivation: 传统系统科学和控制论缺乏内在的伦理治理机制，需要一种能够将道德原则整合到系统架构中的新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统科学、控制论、A3模型（伦理Aram、失真意识Aanavam、代理适应性Adhikaram）、递归道德治理
AI.method: 通过明确的分组件映射分析，将A3框架与经典系统科学和控制论的结构、功能和反射要求进行对比。
AI.findings: A3模型完全满足传统系统科学的所有要求，同时引入了递归伦理一致性作为高阶治理原则，重新将反馈、目的和可行性解释为伦理原语。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个将伦理原则内在化的完整系统架构，代表了控制论和系统科学的新秩序，能够在复杂系统中实现道德和认知完整性。

detail.abstract: In this chapter, we explore how major changes to employment are altering relational dynamics and thus people’s experiences of loneliness in work contexts. We focus on virtual (i.e., hybrid or remote) jobs and gig (i.e., external, contract-based) arrangements, which are increasingly prevalent globally. Drawing on research from multiple literatures (e.g., organizational, social psychology, human-computer interaction), we identify key attributes of virtual jobs and gig arrangements that influence work relationships. First, we suggest that relationships evolve differently in virtual jobs due to limited physical proximity, greater reliance on digital communication technologies, and reduced commuting. Second, we propose that gig arrangements shape relationships through low organizational integration, time-bounded affiliation, and outsider status. These key attributes of virtual jobs and gig arrangements have complex social implications: although they often act as relationship inhibitors—thwarting the development and deepening of interpersonal connections—they can also serve as relationship facilitators—enabling greater relational choice, creativity, and access. Building on our discussion of these mixed effects, we outline fruitful avenues for future research and offer practical recommendations for organizations.

detail.abstract:
The Accelerating Rise of the Gig Economy: Structural Shifts, Digital Platforms, and the Future of Work

This paper analyzes the accelerating structural shift towards the Gig Economy, examining the key socioeconomic drivers and implications of this new labor market paradigm. Drawing on market observations and strategic analysis from the 2016/2017 FinTech landscape, the paper documents the increasing adoption of flexible work and engagement with multiple employers by skilled professionals, fundamentally redefining the concept of traditional employment.

We argue that the current growth of the freelance workforce is not a temporary trend but a sustained, structural transformation fueled by digital platforms and the native freelance orientation of Millennial and Generation Z workers. The analysis explores how this shift is pressuring established corporate structures to adapt and highlights the critical importance of focused reskilling programs (e.g., in digital literacy) for integrating marginalized workers into the burgeoning digital marketplace.

Ultimately, this paper provides a critical assessment of the Gig Economy’s trajectory, predicting its continued expansion and outlining its profound impact on corporate Human Resources strategy, social safety nets, and the long-term future of the global labor market.

detail.abstract: Congressional floor time and public money are increasingly spent on foreign theaters-from Gaza to Ukraine-even as U.S. infrastructure frays. The bipartisan explanation (values, security) obscures a simpler mechanism: donor dependence and foreign-influenced lobbying that shape agenda-setting across both sides of the aisle. This paper argues that liberal and conservative rhetoric operate as a "wash cycle"-different soaps, same machine-while structural drivers (campaign finance, FARA-mediated influence, corporate tax design, and judicial doctrine) remain intact. We pair this with a second myth that also distorts debate: that billionaire wealth is a fixed, indestructible hoard. Historically, large fortunes routinely decay within three generations absent disciplined reinvestment and institutionalization. Durable wealth persists not by hoarding, but by compounding-and by translating assets into policy leverage (think tanks, PACs, endowments, and K Street). We synthesize these threads-foreign lobbying and generational wealth mechanics-to explain why Congress fixates on overseas crises while domestic logistics and working-class concerns stall. The Disclosure & Acknowledgments Produced under The Independent Observer's mission to critique systems over personalities. No funding was received from political organizations, foreign agents, or corporate PACs. Views and any errors are the authors. 2 conclusion outlines structural reforms that target incentives rather than personalities: close the buy-borrow-die loop, hard-cap outside money, wall off foreign-agent spending, and redesign public budgeting so that transit, not outcomes, and press releases govern transit, housing, and basic services.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了美国国会过度关注海外危机而忽视国内问题的结构性原因：外国游说影响和世代财富机制。自由派和保守派言论只是"洗涤周期"的不同肥皂，而结构性驱动因素（竞选资金、外国游说、税收设计和司法原则）保持不变。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国国会越来越关注海外危机（如加沙、乌克兰），而国内基础设施和工人阶级问题却停滞不前？
AI.motivation: 国会时间和公共资金越来越多地用于海外事务，而美国基础设施却在恶化。两党的解释（价值观、安全）掩盖了更简单的机制：捐赠依赖和外国影响的游说。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. "洗涤周期"理论：自由派和保守派言论是不同的肥皂，但机器相同；2. 世代财富衰减理论：大额财富通常在三代内衰减，除非通过制度化和政策杠杆来维持；3. 结构性驱动因素理论：竞选资金、FARA调解的影响、公司税收设计和司法原则。
AI.method: 理论分析和综合方法，将外国游说和世代财富机制两个线索结合起来分析。
AI.findings: 1. 外国游说和捐赠依赖塑造了两党的议程设置；2. 持久财富不是通过囤积，而是通过复利和将资产转化为政策杠杆来维持；3. 国会关注海外危机而忽视国内问题的根本原因是结构性激励问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了"洗涤周期"理论来解释两党言论的相似性；2. 整合了外国游说和世代财富机制两个理论线索；3. 挑战了关于亿万富翁财富是固定不可摧毁的迷思。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了结构性改革建议：关闭"买-借-死"循环、硬性限制外部资金、隔离外国代理人支出、重新设计公共预算，使交通、住房和基本服务由实际需求而非结果和新闻稿决定。

detail.abstract: This white paper further examines the structural disparities embedded within artificial intelligence systems, as revealed by the 7 Races of AI Framework (previously published February 2, 2025, on SSRN). Through an empirical analysis of AI knowledge-tiering, it demonstrates how AI models-despite being constructed on binary logic-continues to exhibit discriminatory information-gating practices, limiting knowledge accessibility based on economic privilege and human based system-level governance. By analyzing discrepancies in free-tier versus paid-tier AI responses, this study establishes that AI is not merely a passive knowledge tool but an assumed regulated ecosystem where access to what is often promoted as unarguable truth is monetized and controlled. The paper then introduces a regionalized AI governance strategy, tailored for policymakers and industry leaders in different global regions, helping to ensure that AI remains an equitable digital entity rather than a controlled gatekeeping system.

AI.tldr: 本文通过7种AI种族框架分析AI系统中的结构性差异，发现尽管AI基于二元逻辑构建，但仍存在基于经济特权的歧视性信息控制实践。研究揭示了免费版与付费版AI响应的差异，表明AI已成为受监管的生态系统，而非被动的知识工具。论文提出了区域化AI治理策略，旨在确保AI成为公平的数字实体。

detail.abstract: The paradox mindset—the proclivity and ability to accept, integrate, and make sense of contradictory yet interrelated elements—has been linked to creativity and innovation. However, little is known about its role in multiple-goal decision making, defined here as strategic choices that simultaneously pursue economic and social/environmental value creation goals, and about whether it can be developed in management education. In a mixed-methods Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT, N = 120), we used a decision-making survey and qualitative analyses to examine the relationship between students’ paradox mindset and multiple-goal pursuit, and to evaluate the impact of a new didactic intervention on the paradox mindset. We find that stronger paradox mindsets positively associate with multiple-goal decision making, and drawing on goal systems theory, argue that stronger (weaker) paradox mindsets are likely to activate facilitative (inhibitory) connections among goals. While paradox mindsets can be situationally activated, the intervention—emphasizing self-regulation in multiple-goal pursuit—had positive but differential effects depending on the baseline paradox mindset. Our study advances paradox pedagogy by demonstrating how business schools can cultivate students’ paradox mindsets, and helps bridge paradox theory and behavioral strategy by showing the paradox mindset’s role in multiple-goal decision-making.

detail.title: Market Reactions to Dividend Increases and Cuts: A Decade-Long Event Study Analysis of the Warsaw Stock Exchange
detail.abstract:
Aim: This study examines how dividend increases and cuts influence stock prices on the Warsaw Stock Exchange over a decade, testing the signaling hypothesis and assessing market efficiency in an emerging market context.

Methodology: Using an event study methodology, the author analyse d 395 dividend increases and 232 decreases (2015-2024). Abnormal returns (AAR, CAAR) were calculated via the Market Model and Constant Mean Model, with statistical significance tested using one-tailed t-tests. 

Findings:Dividend increases triggeredimmediate positive reactions (+1.39% AAR on announcement day, p< 0.005), while cuts led to sharp declines (-1.23% AAR, p< 0.005). Cumulative effects were asymmetric: CAAR for decreases persisted at -2.97% (day +16), whereas post-announcement gains for increases partially reversed. Firms raising dividends exhibitedhigher yield (5.19%) and payout ratios (59.48%), signalling stability. 

Implications and recommendations: Practitioners should prioritise dividend policy as a strategic signal, particularly in emerging markets where reactions are amplified. 

Originality/value: This is the first decade-long event study on the WSE to compare dividend increases and cuts, offering insights into investor behaviour in Central and Eastern Europe. The dual-model approach strengthens reliability, while findings challenge assumptions about market efficiency in emerging economies.

title: Cost Parameters-Based Comprehensive Analysis of a New Cost Function Construction for Coxian-k Queueing System Characterized by Customer Service Speed Variability

detail.title: Cost Parameters-Based Comprehensive Analysis of a New Cost Function Construction for Coxian-k Queueing System Characterized by Customer Service Speed Variability
detail.abstract: This paper presents a novel cost function construction for a single-server queueing system with Poisson input stream, where the customer service time follows a Coxian-k distribution with customer service speed variability. By introducing a parametric structure based on service speed scaling, we derive analytical expressions for key performance measures and construct a cost function that is explicitly expressed in terms of the traffic intensity ρ. The function's convexity is proven, and a unique optimal solution that minimizes the total system cost is identified. Numerical simulations and polynomial regression analyses confirm the model's robustness and predictive accuracy under varying cost conditions. Additionally, a difference-based evaluation of the optimal solutions is performed, and the Wilcoxon signed-rank test confirms the statistical significance of the differences between configurations with different service acceleration factors. These results validate the sensitivity and relevance of the model in guiding robust cost-effective decision-making.

AI.findings: 成本函数具有凸性，存在唯一最优解；模型在不同成本条件下具有鲁棒性和预测准确性；不同服务加速因子配置之间的差异具有统计显著性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于服务速度缩放参数的成本函数构建方法，证明了函数的凸性特征，为排队系统优化提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际排队系统的成本效益决策提供了可操作的优化模型，能够指导服务策略的制定以实现成本最小化。

title: Spatial Infrastructure in the Modern Economy
affiliations: University College London, University of Cambridge

detail.title: Spatial Infrastructure in the Modern Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence their research and the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: This chapter introduces the concept of spatial infrastructure and distinguishes it from locational infrastructure, which is tied to a specific location. Spatial infrastructure facilitates the movement of people, goods, capital, and information between locations. Spatial infrastructure is characterised by an internal space governed by specifically designed rules for the movement of matter. The integrity of this internal space is maintained by controlling entry and exit through selective access points. The chapter argues that equitable access to these selective access points is essential to overcome the spatial unevenness of economic opportunities and activities in a country. Further, the chapter explores the role of the banking network as spatial infrastructure and uses a successful policy experiment in India to show how spatial infrastructure could engender inclusive development in the modern economy.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了空间基础设施和区位基础设施，提出空间基础设施通过特定规则管理内部空间，控制出入口来维持完整性。银行网络作为空间基础设施，其选择性接入点的公平接入对克服经济机会的空间不平等至关重要。
AI.research_question: 空间基础设施如何通过公平接入点促进包容性发展？
AI.motivation: 探讨如何通过空间基础设施克服经济机会和活动的空间不平等问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间基础设施理论、区位基础设施与空间基础设施的区分、内部空间规则设计
AI.method: 概念分析框架构建，结合印度成功的政策实验案例
AI.findings: 银行网络作为空间基础设施能够促进包容性发展，公平接入选择性接入点对克服空间不平等至关重要
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了空间基础设施的概念框架，区分了空间基础设施与区位基础设施，建立了空间基础设施与包容性发展的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过空间基础设施促进包容性发展的实践指导，特别是银行网络在经济发展中的应用
